lessons.title: Frozen defense items not on agenda
lessons.title_zh: 凍結防衛項目不在議程上

paragraphs.en: A historic budget deadlock has delayed more than 150 requests to release defense funds. The Foreign Affairs and National Defense Committee in the Legislative Yuan has not yet arranged a review session for these funds. The Executive Yuan submitted the central government budget proposal for the 2026 fiscal year in August last year, but the opposition-controlled legislature passed it on August 14 after a record review period. Although the Presidential Office promulgated the budget by presidential order in September, committee conveners have not scheduled meetings to unfreeze Ministry of National Defense (MND) funds.
paragraphs.zh: 歷史性的預算僵局延遲了超過150項解凍國防資金的請求。立法院的外交及國防委員會尚未安排這些資金的審查會。行政院於去年8月提交了2026會計年度的中央政府總預算案，但在經過創紀錄的審查期後，由在野黨掌控的立法院才於8月14日三讀通過。儘管總統府已於9月以總統令公布預算，但委員會召集人仍未排定會議來解凍國防部（MND）的資金。

paragraphs.en: The army command reported that it planned to buy spare parts from the United States for M1A2T Abrams tanks. Because the first group of tanks received in 2024 finished its two-year warranty period, the army needs replacement items based on technical specifications and lists from US representatives. The army plans to acquire maintenance parts, critical components, and war reserve stocks totaling thousands of items. Delaying this procurement could negatively affect equipment readiness.
paragraphs.zh: 陸軍司令部報告指出，計畫向美國購買M1A2T奧布蘭斯戰車的備用零件。由於2024年接收的第一批戰車已結束兩年保固期，陸軍需要根據技術規格與美國代表提供的清單來替換品項。陸軍計畫取得維修零件、關鍵組件以及戰備存量，總計數千個項目。延遲這項採購可能會對裝備妥善率造成負面影響。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, opposition lawmakers froze ten percent of a military budget allocation due to worries about restrictive procurement rules and system overlaps. These funds were meant for ground forces to build a common operational picture and enable decentralized command capabilities. With little time left in the fiscal year, the army command warned that these funds might not be unfrozen in time to complete the purchasing process. The committee conveners, KMT Legislator Hsu Chiao-hsin and DPP Legislator Wang Yi-chuan, are currently focusing on other reports and inspections.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，因擔憂限制性採購規則與系統重疊，在野黨立委凍結了十部分項目的軍事預算撥款。這些資金原本是要讓地面部隊建立共同戰場態勢圖並啟用分散式指揮管制能力。隨著會計年度所剩時間不多，陸軍司令部警告這些資金可能無法及時解凍以完成採購流程。委員會召集人、國民黨立委徐巧芯與民進黨立委王義川目前正聚焦於其他報告與考察。

paragraphs.en: In other government news, Premier Cho Jung-tai stated that officials are watching online rumors about a potential pneumonic plague spreading from Russia to China. The government is evaluating border quarantine measures. In foreign affairs, Belize and Paraguay criticized Beijing sanctions against their officials over ties with Taiwan, describing the actions as creating unnecessary tensions. Finally, the Mainland Affairs Council criticized China's Taiwan Affairs Office for imposing sanctions on a firm owned by the father of DPP Legislator Puma Shen, calling it an attempt to pressure Taiwan's democratic society.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他政府消息方面，行政院長卓榮泰表示，官員們正在關注有關可能從俄羅斯蔓延至中國的肺鼠疫的網路謠言。政府正在評估邊境檢疫措施。在外交事務方面，貝里斯與巴拉圭批評北京因其與台灣的關係而對其官員實施制裁，並形容此舉製造了不必要的緊張。最後，大陸委員會批評中國國務院台灣事務辦公室對民進黨立委沈伯洋父親擁有的公司實施制裁，稱這是企圖施壓台灣民主社會的行為。

grammar.point: 過去分詞作形容詞 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 說明被動狀態或已經完成的動作，在此修飾後方名詞。
grammar.example: The Executive Yuan submitted the central government budget proposal for the 2026 fiscal year in August last year, but the opposition-controlled legislature passed it on August 14 after a record review period.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to 加原形動詞來表達做某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: These funds were meant for ground forces to build a common operational picture and enable decentralized command capabilities.

lessons.title: Palau resists China to stand with Taipei: Lai
lessons.title_zh: 帛琉抵抗中國堅定與臺北站在一起：賴清德

paragraphs.en: President William Lai stated that Palau stands firmly with Taiwan despite intense pressure and election interference from Beijing. During an anniversary event for a medical center in Taipei, the Taiwanese leader praised Palauan President Surangel Whipps Jr for his unwavering support on the global stage. Lai noted that Beijing continuously blocks Taiwan from joining international organizations while attempting to pull diplomatic allies into its sphere of influence.
paragraphs.zh: 總統賴清德表示，儘管北京施加強大壓力和進行選舉干預，帛琉仍堅定與臺灣站在一起。在臺北一家醫療中心的週年活動上，這位臺灣領導人讚揚帛琉總統惠恕仁在國際舞臺上給予堅定支持。賴指出，北京持續阻撓臺灣加入國際組織，同時企圖將友邦拉入其勢力範圍。

paragraphs.en: Whipps revealed in a recent interview that Beijing threatened consequences over his nation's diplomatic ties with Taipei, offering tourism and hotel construction in exchange for severing relations. Nevertheless, the island nation remains steadfast, arguing that mutual defense and sovereignty matter greatly. Furthermore, bilateral cooperation in healthcare has deeply strengthened this partnership. A hospital in Taipei has dispatched hundreds of medical professionals to Palau since 2007, significantly upgrading local medical standards.
paragraphs.zh: 惠恕仁在最近的一次採訪中透露，北京曾因該國與臺北的外交關係而威脅要帶來後果，並以觀光和飯店建設作為斷交的交換條件。然而，這個島國依然堅定不移，主張相互防禦和主權至關重要。此外，醫療衛生方面的雙邊合作深化了這種夥伴關係。臺北的一家醫院自2007年起已向帛琉派遣數百名醫療專業人員，大幅提升了當地醫療水準。

paragraphs.en: In other developments, the government is monitoring online rumors regarding a potential disease outbreak spreading from Russia into China, with border quarantine measures already activated. Meanwhile, a tropical storm east of Guam could strengthen into a typhoon, though its path toward Taiwan depends on a high-pressure system. Additionally, Belize and Paraguay recently condemned Beijing's sanctions against their officials due to diplomatic ties with Taipei, emphasizing their right to conduct foreign policy freely. Finally, sanctions imposed by Beijing on a firm tied to a Taiwanese legislator's family were criticized as an egregious attempt to interfere with democratic elections.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他動態方面，政府正在監控有關潛在疾病從俄羅斯傳播到中國的網路傳言，邊境檢疫措施已經啟動。同時，關島以東的一場熱帶風暴可能增強為颱風，不過其朝向臺灣的路徑取決於高壓系統。此外，貝里斯和巴拉圭最近譴責北京因與臺北的外交關係而對其官員實施制裁，強調其自由推動外交政策的權利。最後，北京對與臺灣立法委員家屬有關的公司實施制裁，被批評為干預民主選舉的惡劣企圖。

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞片語作為附加說明，表達伴隨發生的狀況或結果。
grammar.example: President William Lai stated that Palau stands firmly with Taiwan despite intense pressure and election interference from Beijing.
grammar.focus: despite intense pressure and election interference from Beijing

grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞子句來補充說明前面的名詞，提供更多相關背景細節。
grammar.example: Whipps revealed in a recent interview that Beijing threatened consequences over his nation's diplomatic ties with Taipei, offering tourism and hotel construction in exchange for severing relations.
grammar.focus: offering tourism and hotel construction in exchange for severing relations

grammar.explain: 使用「be 動詞加過去分詞」來強調動作承受者，不強調執行者。
grammar.example: In other developments, the government is monitoring online rumors regarding a potential disease outbreak spreading from Russia into China, with border quarantine measures already activated.

lessons.title: Typhoon Champi sea warning possible Wednesday
lessons.title_zh: 颱風薔琵海上警報週三可能發布

paragraphs.en: Taiwan could issue a maritime warning for Typhoon Champi as soon as Wednesday evening, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA). Officials noted that an alert for land areas might follow late Thursday or Friday as the storm moves closer to the island. The storm is projected to affect Taiwan most severely on Friday and Saturday, delivering heavy rainfall to northern and central regions, along with Yilan and Hualien counties in the east.
paragraphs.zh: 根據交通部中央氣象署（CWA）表示，台灣最快可能在週三晚間發布颱風薔琵的海上警報。氣象人員指出，隨著颱風逼近台灣，陸上警報可能會在週四晚間或週五接續發布。預計該颱風在週五和週六對台灣的影響最為劇烈，將為台灣北部與中部地區，以及東部的宜蘭縣和花蓮縣帶來豪雨。

paragraphs.en: Around 2 p.m. yesterday, Champi was roughly 2,470 kilometers east-southeast of Oluanpi, the southernmost point of Taiwan, traveling west-northwest at 20 kilometers per hour. CWA data showed that it packed maximum sustained winds of 191 kilometers per hour with a storm radius of 200 kilometers. Forecasters predict that the storm will retain its power as it advances toward the ocean northeast of Taiwan.
paragraphs.zh: 截至昨天下午2點，薔琵位於台灣最南端鵝鑾鼻東南方約2,470公里處，以每小時20公里的速度向西北西移動。氣象署資料顯示，其中心最大持續風速達到每小時191公里，暴風半徑為200公里。預報員預測，該颱風在朝台灣東北部海域前進時將維持其強度。

paragraphs.en: While certain predictive models indicate that the storm might strike eastern Taiwan, its precise route remains uncertain due to the shifting Pacific high-pressure system. Forecaster Liu Pei-teng explained that if the high-pressure system weakens earlier than expected, Champi could shift northward before nearing Taiwan. However, should this atmospheric system gain strength, the typhoon might follow a more southern path or cross the Bashi Channel between Taiwan and the Philippines.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然部分預測模式顯示該颱風可能會登陸台灣東部，但由於太平洋高壓系統的變化，其確切路徑仍充滿不確定性。預報員劉沛滕解釋，如果高壓系統比預期更早減弱，薔琵可能會在接近台灣之前轉向北方。然而，如果該氣壓系統增強，颱風可能會採取偏南的路徑，或是穿過台灣與菲律賓之間的巴士海峽。

paragraphs.en: Global weather simulations still present differing routes, making tomorrow crucial in deciding whether the storm veers north. Prior to the storm's arrival, conditions across Taiwan are expected to stay fairly calm today and tomorrow, featuring mostly cloudy to sunny skies. Only scattered, brief showers are likely along the Keelung coast, in northeastern and southeastern regions, and across the Hengchun Peninsula.
paragraphs.zh: 國際天氣模擬仍持續呈現分歧的路徑，這使得明天成為決定該颱風是否北轉的關鍵。在颱風來臨之前，全台各地的天氣在今天和明天預計保持相對穩定，大多為多雲到晴的天氣。僅有基隆海岸、東北部與東南部地區，以及恆春半島可能出現零星短暫陣雨。

grammar.point: 介系詞片語表示依據 (Prepositional Phrase of Attribution)
grammar.explain: according to 為常見介系詞片語，後接名詞或機構名稱，用來說明消息來源或參考依據。
grammar.example: Taiwan could issue a maritime warning for Typhoon Champi as soon as Wednesday evening, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).
grammar.focus: according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA)

grammar.explain: 在主要子句之後以逗號隔開，使用現在分詞 making 引導分詞構句，表示前面整件事帶來的伴隨結果。
grammar.example: Global weather simulations still present differing routes, making tomorrow crucial in deciding whether the storm veers north.

grammar.point: 假設語氣倒裝句 (Inverted Conditional Clause)
grammar.explain: 省略條件句連接詞 if，將助動詞 should 移至主詞之前形成倒裝，用來表示對未來情況的假設。
grammar.example: However, should this atmospheric system gain strength, the typhoon might follow a more southern path or cross the Bashi Channel between Taiwan and the Philippines.
grammar.focus: should this atmospheric system gain strength

lessons.title: Don't fall for this - how to protect yourself from AI scams
lessons.title_zh: 別上當——如何保護自己免受人工智慧詐騙之害

paragraphs.en: Shoppers are facing new risks as criminals use artificial intelligence to make online scams more convincing. According to National Trading Standards, fraudsters are building fake shopping websites that pretend to be family-owned businesses selling high-quality British products. Customers who order from these pages often receive nothing at all, or they get cheap, mass-produced items from other countries.
paragraphs.zh: 購物者正面臨新的風險，因為犯罪分子正利用人工智慧讓網路詐騙變得更加逼真。根據英國國家交易標準局（National Trading Standards）的說法，詐騙份子正在架設虛假的購物網站，假裝是銷售優質英國製造產品的家族企業。從這些頁面訂購的顧客往往什麼都收不到，或者收到來自其他國家的廉價大量生產商品。

paragraphs.en: To warn the public, National Trading Standards has created its first AI scam watchlist. This list shows how criminals create professional-looking websites quickly at low costs. In romance scams, artificial intelligence helps scammers remember personal details and hold conversations with victims for months. In addition, deepfake videos and cloned voices are used to impersonate family members or close friends who are supposedly asking for money in an "emergency." Criminals can also produce countless phishing emails and messages without any language mistakes.
paragraphs.zh: 為了向大眾提出警告，英國國家交易標準局制定了第一份人工智慧詐騙觀察名單。這份名單展示了犯罪分子如何以低成本迅速創建外觀專業的網站。在交友戀愛詐騙中，人工智慧協助詐騙份子記住個人細節，並與受害者保持長達數月的對話。此外，深偽影片與複製的聲音被用來冒充家人或摯友，假裝在「緊急狀況」下要錢。犯罪分子還能大規模產出毫無語言錯誤的釣魚電子郵件與訊息。

paragraphs.en: Because of these technological developments, traditional warning signs are no longer reliable. The consumer group Which? points out that people cannot simply depend on spelling or grammatical errors to identify fraudulent messages. Since AI tools can write perfect text, even educated consumers can easily fall for these tricks.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些技術的發展，傳統的警訊不再可靠。消費者團體 Which? 指出，人們不能再單純依靠拼字或文法錯誤來辨識詐騙訊息。既然人工智慧工具能夠撰寫完美的文字，即使是受過良好教育的消費者也很容易受騙。

paragraphs.en: Trading standards experts have shared several key tips to help people stay safe. They advise shoppers never to send money, gift cards, or financial details to individuals they have never met face to face. People should always do research by checking physical addresses and verifying whether financial companies are officially authorized. Furthermore, seeing or hearing someone on a video or phone call does not prove that the person is genuine.
paragraphs.zh: 交易標準局的專家分享了幾項關鍵要點來協助大眾保持安全。他們建議購物者絕不要向未曾親自謀面的人匯款、寄送禮物卡或提供財務資料。民眾應當總是透過查證實體地址，並確認金融公司是否獲得正式授權來進行調查。此外，在視訊或通話中看到或聽到某人，並不能證明該人就是真實的。

paragraphs.en: Above all, consumers should pause and think before acting, especially when facing intense pressure to send funds immediately. Anyone who encounters a scam in the UK can report it to Report Fraud or contact the Citizens Advice Consumer Helpline for guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 最重要的是，消費者在採取行動之前應該停下來思考，特別是當面臨立即匯款的巨大壓力時。任何在英國遇到詐騙的人都可以向 Report Fraud 舉報，或聯繫公民諮詢處消費者求助專線（Citizens Advice Consumer Helpline）尋求指引。

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 引導的名詞子句置於動詞 points out 之後，作為該動詞的受詞。
grammar.example: The consumer group Which? points out that people cannot simply depend on spelling or grammatical errors to identify fraudulent messages.
grammar.focus: that people cannot simply depend on spelling or grammatical errors to identify fraudulent messages

grammar.point: 現在分詞作後位修飾 (Present Participle as Postmodifier)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞片語 selling high-quality British products 接在名詞 businesses 之後，修飾該名詞。
grammar.example: According to National Trading Standards, fraudsters are building fake shopping websites that pretend to be family-owned businesses selling high-quality British products.

grammar.point: 不定詞片語表目的 (Infinitive Phrase of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to help people stay safe 在句中表示目的，說明專家分享建議的用意。
grammar.example: Trading standards experts have shared several key tips to help people stay safe.

lessons.title: Mission set to blast off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
lessons.title_zh: 任務即將升空前往火星以採集其衛星碎片

paragraphs.en: A major space mission led by the Japanese Space Agency is preparing to launch on Monday. The Mars Moons Exploration (MMX) spacecraft aims to collect a sample from Phobos, one of the two moons of Mars, and bring it back to Earth. If the journey succeeds, scientists will receive the first-ever soil returned from Mars or its moons for direct study in laboratories.
paragraphs.zh: 一項由日本太空總署主導的重大太空任務正準備於週一發射升空。火星衛星探測（MMX）太空船旨在從火星的兩顆衛星之一「火衛一」採集樣本，並將其帶回地球。如果這趟旅程成功，科學家將獲得有史以來第一批從火星或其衛星帶回的土壤，以便在實驗室中直接進行研究。

paragraphs.en: The spacecraft is scheduled to reach Phobos in August 2027. Unlike our large Moon, Phobos and Deimos are tiny, irregular objects that look somewhat like potatoes. Setting down on Phobos is extremely difficult because the tiny moon has very weak gravity, while nearby Mars exerts a powerful gravitational pull. Before landing the main spacecraft, a small rover will explore the surface to find a safe landing site.
paragraphs.zh: 該太空船預計於2027年8月抵達火衛一。與我們巨大的月球不同，火衛一和火衛二都是微小且形狀不規則的天體，看起來有點像馬鈴薯。降落在火衛一上極為困難，因為這顆微小的衛星本身重力非常微弱，而鄰近的火星則施加著強大的重力引力。在主要太空船降落之前，一輛小型探測車將先探索地表，以尋找安全的著陸點。

paragraphs.en: Once the spacecraft touches down, it will use a robotic arm and two tools to collect about 10 grams of dust. Although this amount seems tiny, Dr Chrysa Avdellidou from Leicester University stated that "it's worth every gram" because researchers can examine even individual grains. The material will be sealed in a small capsule, which is expected to return to Earth in 2031 and touch down in South Australia's Woomera desert.
paragraphs.zh: 太空船一旦著陸，將利用機械手臂和兩具取樣器採集約十公克的塵埃。儘管這個數量看似極少，但來自萊斯特大學的克里莎・阿夫德利杜博士表示「每一公克都值得」，因為研究人員連單一微粒都能進行檢視。這些物質將被密封在一個小型密封艙中，預計於2031年返回地球，並降落在南澳的伍默拉沙漠。

paragraphs.en: Scientists hope this rare sample will finally solve the mystery of how the Martian moons formed. The rocks could show whether Phobos was created from debris after a giant impact on Mars or if it was an asteroid captured by the planet's gravity. Prof Sara Russell from the Natural History Museum also noted that dust from Mars might have landed on Phobos over time. Therefore, the mission may also provide pristine fragments of Mars itself, free from the contamination that affects Martian meteorites on Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 科學家希望這個珍貴的樣本能最終解開火星衛星如何形成的謎團。這些岩石可以顯示火衛一究竟是在火星遭受巨大撞擊後的碎片所形成，抑或是被這顆行星的重力所捕獲的小行星。來自自然史博物館的莎拉・羅素教授也指出，隨著時間推移，來自火星的塵埃可能已經落到了火衛一上。因此，這項任務也可能提供火星本身未受污染的純淨碎片，免於地球上影響火星隕石的污染。

vocab.zh: 原始的；純淨未受污染的

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的關係代名詞「which」引導非限定關係子句，針對先行詞「a small capsule」進行補充說明。
grammar.example: The material will be sealed in a small capsule, which is expected to return to Earth in 2031 and touch down in South Australia's Woomera desert.
grammar.focus: , which is expected to return to Earth in 2031 and touch down in South Australia's Woomera desert

grammar.point: 條件副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Condition)
grammar.explain: 連接詞「If」引導條件副詞子句，在描述未來可能發生的假設情況時，子句動詞使用現在簡單式代替未來式。
grammar.example: If the journey succeeds, scientists will receive the first-ever soil returned from Mars or its moons for direct study in laboratories.

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as an Object)
grammar.explain: 連接詞「whether... or...」引導名詞子句，在此作為主要動詞「show」的受詞，表達「是否……抑或……」的選擇含義。
grammar.example: The rocks could show whether Phobos was created from debris after a giant impact on Mars or if it was an asteroid captured by the planet's gravity.

lessons.title: EPA quietly backtracks on claims US has phased out toxic Pfas compounds
lessons.title_zh: 美國環保署悄悄撤回關於美國已淘汰有毒全氟／多氟烷基物質（Pfas）說法的報導

paragraphs.en: The United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has quietly updated its website to remove claims that two dangerous chemicals, Pfoa and Pfos, have been completely phased out in the US. These substances are known to present severe risks to human health, yet a Texas-based firm continues to produce them.
paragraphs.zh: 美國環境保護署（EPA）已悄悄更新其網站，刪除了關於美國已完全淘汰兩種危險化學物質 Pfoa 和 Pfos 的說法。這些物質已知會對人類健康構成嚴重威脅，然而一家總部位於德州的企業仍在繼續生產它們。

paragraphs.en: In 2015, the EPA reached an agreement with eight producers to stop making Pfoa and Pfos after landmark litigation revealed their dangers. Although officials often claimed the chemicals were no longer produced, independent science suggests they have been made in the US this whole time at high levels.
paragraphs.zh: 在 2015 年，一場具有里程碑意義的訴訟揭露了這些化學物質的危險性後，美國環保署與八家生產商達成協議，停止製造 Pfoa 和 Pfos。儘管官員經常聲稱這些化學物質不再生產，但獨立科學研究表明，它們這段期間一直在美國以高濃度被製造。

paragraphs.en: The issue centers on Houston-based Inhance, which makes millions of barriers annually for plastic containers. The EPA previously ordered the company to stop manufacturing Pfoa, but a federal appeals court overturned the ban, and a later lawsuit brought by a non-profit group was dismissed.
paragraphs.zh: 問題的核心在於總部位於休士頓的 Inhance 公司，該公司每年為塑膠容器製造數百萬個阻隔層。美國環保署先前曾命令該公司停止製造 Pfoa，但聯邦上訴法院推翻了這項禁令，隨後一個非營利組織發起訴訟也被駁回。

paragraphs.en: Following a complaint filed under the Information Quality Act by the non-profit Public Employees for Environmental Responsibility (Peer), the EPA admitted that quantities of Pfoa and Pfos may still be produced and used by companies. A former EPA scientist noted that the agency was giving a false impression about production.
paragraphs.zh: 在非營利組織「公共員工環境責任組織」（Peer）根據《資訊品質法》提出申訴後，美國環保署承認，企業可能仍在生產和使用一定數量的 Pfoa 和 Pfos。一位前美國環保署科學家指出，該機構先前一直在生產問題上給外界錯誤的印象。

paragraphs.en: Inhance stated that its products do not present an unreasonable risk and that it reduced impurities significantly. Meanwhile, critics argue that the EPA needs to issue actual bans rather than just phase-outs for chemicals that have no safe level of exposure.
paragraphs.zh: Inhance 公司表示其產品不會構成不合理的風險，並且已顯著減少雜質。同時，批評者認為，對於沒有安全暴露水準的化學物質，美國環保署需要發布真正的禁令，而不僅僅是淘汰措施。

grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，句型為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: These substances are known to present severe risks to human health, yet a Texas-based firm continues to produce them.

grammar.explain: 使用 which 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞 plastic containers。
grammar.example: The issue centers on Houston-based Inhance, which makes millions of barriers annually for plastic containers.
grammar.focus: which makes millions of barriers annually for plastic containers

grammar.explain: 用逗號隔開的 V-ing 分詞片語，表達伴隨的情況或結果。
