lessons.title: Fuel leak spreads more than two miles along River Taff
lessons.title_zh: 燃料外洩沿著塔夫河擴散超過兩英里

paragraphs.en: A widespread fuel leak has affected the River Taff, prompting authorities to advise local residents to keep their doors and windows closed. Natural Resources Wales (NRW), an environmental body, received multiple reports about pollution affecting locations such as Nantgarw, Treforest, and Taffs Well. Officials later confirmed that up to 25,000 litres of kerosene entered the river.
paragraphs.zh: 一起廣泛的燃料外洩事件影響了塔夫河 (River Taff)，促使當局建議當地居民保持門窗緊閉。環境保護機構威爾斯自然資源署 (Natural Resources Wales,簡稱 NRW) 收到多起關於污染影響南特加羅 (Nantgarw)、特雷福雷斯特 (Treforest) 與塔夫斯韋爾 (Taffs Well) 等地的通報。官方隨後證實，有多達 25,000 公升的煤油流入河中。

paragraphs.en: GE Aerospace confirmed that fuel leaked into the water during repair work at its nearby site. The source of the spill was identified on Friday evening, and officials have been working to find how the substance entered the underground drainage system. Because of high water flows and the width of the channel, workers could not use standard absorbent barriers directly on the river.
paragraphs.zh: 奇異航太 (GE Aerospace) 證實，燃料是在其附近的廠房進行維修工作時滲漏到水中的。這起外洩事件的源頭於週五傍晚被確認，官方一直在努力查明該物質是如何進入地下排水系統的。由於水流湍急且河道寬闊，工作人員無法直接在河面上使用標準的吸油屏障。

paragraphs.en: Specialist contractors were sent to the site to remove the fuel, and absorbents were placed at the confluence between the impacted tributary and the River Taff. As stated by the GE Aerospace, "The safety of our employees, neighbours, and environment is our top priority." Action taken over the weekend significantly reduced the amount of pollution entering the waterway.
paragraphs.zh: 專業承包商被派往現場清除燃料，並在受影響的支流與塔夫河的匯流處放置了吸油劑。正如奇異航太所言：「我們員工、鄰居和環境的安全是我們的首要任務。」週末採取的行動大幅減少了進入水道的污染量。

paragraphs.en: Residents near the river reported strong fumes that caused physical discomfort and sleep disruption. Water samples have been collected to check the environmental impact, and dead fish were recovered from the river for evidence. Public Health Wales advised nearby residents to avoid contact with the water and call health services if they felt unwell.
paragraphs.zh: 居住在河邊的居民通報了強烈的氣體異味，這造成了身體不適與睡眠干擾。水樣已被收集以檢查環境影響，死魚也從河中被撈起作為證據。威爾斯公共衛生局 (Public Health Wales) 建議附近的居民避免接觸水體，若感到身體不適應撥打醫療服務專線。

paragraphs.en: Experts noted that restoring the environment will take a very long time because the spill has severely damaged the local ecosystem. While the smell has died down and the discharge has decreased, investigation work remains ongoing to stop the pollution completely.
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出，恢復環境需要很長的時間，因為這次外洩嚴重破壞了當地生態系統。雖然氣味已經消散且排放量已減少，但調查工作仍在持續進行以徹底阻止污染。

grammar.explain: 本句使用被動語態表示「燃料外洩事件影響了塔夫河」的動作承受者為主體，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: A widespread fuel leak has affected the River Taff, prompting authorities to advise local residents to keep their doors and windows closed.

grammar.explain: 本句使用現在分詞作分詞構句，補充說明前面子句所引發的結果。
grammar.example: A widespread fuel leak has affected the River Taff, prompting authorities to advise local residents to keep their doors and windows closed.
grammar.focus: prompting authorities to advise local residents to keep their doors and windows closed

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 本句中的不定詞片語用來表達進行調查的目的，即「為了徹底阻止污染」。
grammar.example: While the smell has died down and the discharge has decreased, investigation work remains ongoing to stop the pollution completely.

lessons.title: The University of Nevada now offers students the opportunity to minor in mariachi
lessons.title_zh: 內華達大學現為學生提供副修墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂的機會

paragraphs.en: Mariachi music has gained huge popularity among young people across the United States. Thousands of high school students who used to join typical choirs, bands, or orchestras now choose to take mariachi classes instead. This traditional Mexican style of music is spreading quickly in border areas like Texas and other regions with large Latino populations. Because interest is growing so fast, the demand for instructors has outpaced the available supply.
paragraphs.zh: 墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂（mariachi）全美年輕人之間獲得了極大的人氣。數以千計過去可能參加典型合唱團、樂團或管弦樂團的高中生，如今轉而選擇上墨西哥街頭樂隊課程。這種傳統的墨西哥音樂風格在德州等邊境地區以及其他擁有大量拉丁裔人口的區域迅速傳播。由於興趣增長極為迅速，對教師的需求已經超過了現有的供應。

paragraphs.en: To help solve this shortage, the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV), has introduced a brand-new minor program in teaching mariachi. Stephen Blanco, the director of mariachi at UNLV, is leading the effort to train future educators. Blanco grew up in Detroit, where the music was rarely played, but he later discovered the incredible enthusiasm for the genre during a performance trip with his high school ensemble in California.
paragraphs.zh: 為了協助解決這項短缺，內華達大學拉斯維加斯分校（UNLV）推出了一個全新的教學副修課程。該校的墨西哥街頭樂隊總監史蒂芬·布蘭科（Stephen Blanco）正帶領這項工作，培訓未來的教育工作者。布蘭科在底特律長大，那裡很少播放這種音樂，但他後來在帶著高中樂團前往加州演出的旅途中，發現了人們對該音樂類型的驚人熱情。

paragraphs.en: Violinist Axel Rodriguez Olivas became the very first student to declare this new minor at UNLV. He started learning mariachi under Blanco during high school and immediately developed a deep passion for it. For Rodriguez Olivas, studying this art form is not just about earning college credits. It also serves as a meaningful bridge that connects him to his Mexican American family, inspiring deeper conversations at home about their cultural roots.
paragraphs.zh: 小提琴手阿克塞爾·羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯（Axel Rodriguez Olivas）成為該校第一位申報這項新副修的學生。他在高中時期就跟隨布蘭科學習墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂，並立刻對其產生了深厚的熱情。對羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯而言，研讀這種藝術形式不僅僅是為了取得大學學分。它還充當了一座有意義的橋樑，將他與他的墨西哥裔美國家庭連結在一起，激發了家中關於其文化根源的更深層對話。

paragraphs.en: According to Blanco, mariachi has evolved beyond background entertainment at festivals. Today, audiences in Las Vegas gather in beautiful theaters to watch full concerts where mariachi acts take center stage. Furthermore, the new university minor helps satisfy the need for teachers in Clark County public schools, which are opening new programs each year.
paragraphs.zh: 根據布蘭科的說法，墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂已經演變為不僅僅是節慶中的背景娛樂。如今，拉斯維加斯的觀眾聚集在美麗的劇院裡觀看完整的音樂會，墨西哥街頭樂隊表演在其中成為舞台焦點。此外，這項新的大學副修課程有助於滿足克拉克郡公立學校對教師的需求，這些學校每年都在開設新的課程。

paragraphs.en: With many job possibilities ahead, Rodriguez Olivas is considering staying in Nevada after graduation so that he can teach local youth. As Rodriguez Olivas explained, he wants to "pave that path for them" so future generations can enjoy the musical culture.
paragraphs.zh: 面對未來的許多工作機會，羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯正在考慮畢業後留在內華達州，以便教導當地的年輕人。正如羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯所解釋的，他希望「為他們鋪平這條道路」，讓未來的世代能夠享受這種音樂文化。

grammar.explain: 先行詞「Thousands of high school students」由關係代名詞「who」引導關係子句，在子句中作主詞使用。
grammar.example: Thousands of high school students who used to join typical choirs, bands, or orchestras now choose to take mariachi classes instead.
grammar.focus: who used to join typical choirs, bands, or orchestras

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語「To help solve this shortage」放在句首，用來表達後面主要子句動作的目的，意思為「為了協助解決這個短缺」。
grammar.example: To help solve this shortage, the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV), has introduced a brand-new minor program in teaching mariachi.

grammar.explain: 由「has」加上過去分詞「evolved」構成現在完成式，表示從過去持續到現在的演變狀態。
grammar.example: According to Blanco, mariachi has evolved beyond background entertainment at festivals.

lessons.title: US workers facing deadly heat borrow from tomato pickers to win key protections
lessons.title_zh: 美國勞工面臨致命高溫，借鏡番茄採收工爭取關鍵保障

paragraphs.en: As extreme heat poses severe health risks across the United States, workers in outdoor fields and indoor facilities lack basic federal protections. This summer was the hottest on record in the country, and climate scientists expect such dangerous temperatures to become even more frequent. While government efforts to establish rules have stalled, labor groups are now adopting a successful strategy originally created by tomato pickers decades ago.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著極端高溫在美國各地構成嚴重的健康風險，戶外農田與室內設施的勞工缺乏基本的聯邦保障。今年夏天是該國有紀錄以來最熱的一年，氣候科學家預期此類危險的高溫將變得更加頻繁。儘管政府建立規則的努力陷入停滯，勞工團體目前正採用數十年前由番茄採收工最初創建的成功策略。

paragraphs.en: In the early 1990s, Lucas Benitez helped found the Coalition of Immokalee Workers (CIW) in Florida. The organization established a fair food program that forces major brands to improve conditions. Instead of targeting small farms, this model uses market enforcement against well-known food retailers. Retailers agree to pay extra money to buy crops only from farms that follow strict safety codes, while violating farms lose their preferred status.
paragraphs.zh: 在1990年代初期，盧卡斯·班尼特（Lucas Benitez）協助在佛羅里達州創立了「伊莫卡利農場工人聯盟」（Coalition of Immokalee Workers, 簡稱 CIW）。該組織建立了一個公平食品計畫，迫使各大品牌改善工作條件。這個模式不以小型農場為目標，而是對知名的食品零售商使用市場執行力。零售商同意支付額外費用，僅向遵守嚴格安全規範的農場購買作物，而違規的農場則會失去其優選地位。

paragraphs.en: To achieve these results, the coalition used intense protests and hunger strikes against famous corporations like Taco Bell and McDonald’s. Students also boycotted the companies until they agreed to the demands. Today, other groups are copying this approach for different hot, low-wage jobs, such as dairy production and indoor plant growing. In Florida, an organization named WeCount is leading a similar campaign to protect local plant workers from dangerous heat.
paragraphs.zh: 為了達到這些成果，該聯盟對塔可鐘（Taco Bell）和麥當勞等知名企業展開了強烈的抗議與絕食抗議。學生也抵制這些公司，直到牠們同意訴求。如今，其他團體正在為不同的炎熱低薪工作（如乳品生產和室內植物種殖）複製這項作法。在佛羅里達州，一個名為 WeCount 的組織正領導一場類似的運動，以保護當地植物工人免受危險高溫的危害。

paragraphs.en: However, workers still face heavy obstacles at different government levels. Although WeCount previously tried to pass local county rules with strict monetary penalties and paid rest breaks, the state legislature blocked the local ordinance by passing a pre-emptive law. Furthermore, proposed federal standards under the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (Osha) remain stalled due to political opposition. Because official protections are lacking, workers continue to suffer from severe illnesses and tragic deaths while trying to make a living.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，工人在不同的政府層級仍面臨沉重障礙。儘管 WeCount 先前試過通過具有嚴格金錢罰則與帶薪休息時間的當地郡級規則，但州議會透過一項預先 preemptive 的法律擋下了該地方條例。此外，在職業安全與衛生管理局（Occupational Safety and Health Administration, 簡稱 Osha）之下的擬議聯邦標準，也因政治反對而持續停滯。由於缺乏官方保障，工人在努力謀生時，仍持續遭受嚴重的疾病與悲慘的死亡。

paragraphs.en: Despite these setbacks, the fair food model continues to expand to major growers like Costa Farms. Leaders believe that if major growers join this standard, it will signal to retailers that the industry is ready for change. As Lucas Benitez noted, targeting brand reputations gives workers a powerful tool to enforce safety when government regulations fail.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管遭遇這些挫折，公平食品模式仍持續擴展到像是柯斯達農場（Costa Farms）這樣的大型種植商。領導者們認為，如果大型種植商加入這項標準，將會向零售商發出信號，表明產業界已準備好迎接改變。正如盧卡斯·班尼特所指出，當政府法規失效時，針對品牌聲譽能賦予工人一項強大的工具來強制執行安全。

grammar.explain: 用來連接子句並修飾前方先行詞的關係代名詞，在此引導形容詞子句補充說明工作條件。
grammar.example: The organization established a fair food program that forces major brands to improve conditions.
grammar.focus: that forces major brands to improve conditions

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」置於句中或句尾來表達目的，在此說明採取行動是為了保護當地植物工人。
grammar.example: In Florida, an organization named WeCount is leading a similar campaign to protect local plant workers from dangerous heat.
grammar.focus: to protect local plant workers from dangerous heat

lessons.title: Even LinkedIn is getting tired of your AI-written posts
lessons.title_zh: 連LinkedIn也開始對你用AI寫的貼文感到厭煩了

paragraphs.en: In recent months, the professional networking platform LinkedIn has faced heavy criticism for a massive wave of dull, computer-generated posts. As artificial intelligence makes it remarkably cheap and simple to produce large amounts of text, websites across the internet have struggled with this low-quality content, often called slop. While platforms such as YouTube, Pinterest, and Spotify have tried to limit such spam, LinkedIn has been affected especially severely by the trend.
paragraphs.zh: 最近幾個月，專業社群平台LinkedIn因為大量乏味的電腦生成貼文而面臨嚴厲批評。由於人工智慧讓產生成本低廉且簡單的大量文字變得前所未有地容易，網際網路上的各大網站都在努力應付這種被稱為「電子廚餘」的低品質內容。雖然YouTube、Pinterest和Spotify等平台都試圖限制這種垃圾訊息，但LinkedIn受此趨勢的影響尤為嚴重。

paragraphs.en: Research published by a firm called Pangram in July revealed that over forty percent of long-form articles on the site were created by artificial intelligence. This percentage was notably higher than the numbers recorded on other platforms like X and Medium. Consequently, the company has decided to step up its efforts to fight against these generic messages. Dan Roth, the editor-in-chief of the platform, explained that what truly works on the site is being human.
paragraphs.zh: 一家名為Pangram的公司在七月發布的研究顯示，該網站上超過百分之四十的長篇文章是由人工智慧所創作。這個比例明顯高於X和Medium等其他平台上所記錄的數字。因此，該公司決定加強打擊這些千篇一律的訊息。該平台的總編輯Dan Roth解釋說，在網站上真正有效的方法是展現人性。

paragraphs.en: Although LinkedIn is owned by Microsoft, which encourages users to adopt its technology tools, low-quality posts create a serious business problem for the platform. If members continuously view generic content instead of meaningful professional insights, the company risks losing them to other services. To address this issue, the organization introduced a special button in August allowing users to report posts that look like computer-generated slop.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然LinkedIn由微軟所有，而微軟鼓勵使用者採用其技術工具，但低品質的貼文卻為該平台帶來了嚴重的商業問題。如果會員持續看到千篇一律的內容而非有意義的專業見解，該公司將面臨把他們失去給其他服務的風險。為了解決這個問題，該組織在八月推出了一個特殊的按鈕，允許使用者檢舉看起來像電腦生成垃圾訊息的貼文。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the company has formed a special team composed of former journalists and social media experts to train its systems to recognize useful, authentic articles. Posts flagged by these advanced models are much less likely to be distributed beyond a user's direct connections. At the same time, content advisors are working with executives to encourage imperfection, reminding them that readers value genuine thoughts over overly polished technology output.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，該公司組成了一個由前記者和社群媒體專家組成的特別團隊，來訓練其系統識別有用且真實的文章。被這些先進模型標記的貼文，不太可能被散布到使用者直接連結之外的範圍。同時，內容顧問也正與高階主管合作，鼓勵展現不完美之處，提醒他們讀者更重視真實的想法，而不是過度修飾的技術產出。

paragraphs.en: These combined strategies are already showing early signs of positive results. Recent improvements in detection systems have led to a significant forty percent drop in views for content classified as computer-generated slop. While the platform is not entirely opposed to technology tools, it continues to push people to express themselves naturally, which is required to stand out among the heavy noise.
paragraphs.zh: 這些結合起來的策略已經展現出正面成果的早期跡象。偵測系統最近的改善，已經導致被歸類為電腦生成垃圾訊息的內容瀏覽量大幅下降了百分之四十。雖然該平台並非完全反對技術工具，但它仍持續推動人們自然地表達自己，這是從龐大雜音中脫穎而出所必需的條件。

grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，句型為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: While platforms such as YouTube, Pinterest, and Spotify have tried to limit such spam, LinkedIn has been affected especially severely by the trend.

grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞的形容詞子句，此處由受格關代 which 引導。
grammar.example: To address this issue, the organization introduced a special button in August allowing users to report posts that look like computer-generated slop.

grammar.explain: 用現在分詞 V-ing 開頭的分詞構句，表達附帶的動作或結果，沒有連接詞。
grammar.example: Recent improvements in detection systems have led to a significant forty percent drop in views for content classified as computer-generated slop.

lessons.title: Historic day in college football sees 5 of the top 7 teams in the Top 25 losing in the regular season for the first time
lessons.title_zh: 大學美式足球歷史性的一天：美聯社排名前七的球隊中有五支在例行賽落敗

paragraphs.en: College football history was made on a single Saturday when five of the top seven teams in the Associated Press Top 25 rankings lost their regular-season games. This surprising outcome was largely driven by the Southeastern Conference, where top-ranked teams suffered unexpected defeats against heavy odds.
paragraphs.zh: 美式足球歷史在某個週六寫下新頁，當時美聯社排名前二十五名（Associated Press Top 25）中的五支頂尖球隊在例行賽中落敗。這個令人驚訝的結果主要由東南部聯盟（Southeastern Conference）所主導，排名領先的球隊在懸殊的賠率下吞下了意料之外的敗仗。

paragraphs.en: The number one Georgia team fell to unranked Auburn after Gunner Stockton committed crucial turnovers late in the game. Meanwhile, the second-ranked Texas team also lost at home against Florida as Arch Manning faced heavy defensive pressure. In another major matchup, fourth-ranked Ohio State secured a victory against fifth-ranked Indiana when a late touchdown attempt failed.
paragraphs.zh: 排名第一的喬治亞隊在甘納·史塔克頓（Gunner Stockton）於比賽尾聲發生關鍵失誤後，敗給了未列入排名的奧本隊。同時，排名第二的德州大學也在主場敗給佛羅里達隊，當時亞奇·曼寧（Arch Manning）面臨沉重的防守壓力。在另一場重要對決中，排名第四的俄亥俄州立大學在一次美妙的達陣嘗試失敗後，擊敗了排名第五的印第安納大學。

paragraphs.en: Sixth-ranked Alabama and seventh-ranked Texas also experienced losses on the same dramatic day, creating a massive shakeup in the standings. These results paved the way for third-ranked Miami to potentially claim the top spot in the poll following a controversial double-overtime victory over Florida State.
paragraphs.zh: 排名第六的阿拉巴馬隊和排名第七的德州大學也在同一個戲劇性的一天吞下敗仗，在排位中造成了巨大的洗牌。這些結果為排名第三的邁阿密隊在延長兩次加時賽艱辛擊敗佛羅里達州立大學後，爭取排名榜首鋪平了道路。

paragraphs.en: Coaches and players are now working hard to rebuild their teams after these setbacks. As Auburn coach Alex Golesh mentioned while trying to lift his players, the goal is to improve one game at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 在這些挫折之後，教練和球員們現在正努力重建他們的球隊。正如奧本教練亞歷克斯·戈萊什（Alex Golesh）試圖鼓舞球員時所提到的，目標是一場比賽一場比賽地進步。

grammar.explain: 說明前方帶有名詞的地方，使用了which來引導形容詞子句補充說明。
grammar.example: This surprising outcome was largely driven by the Southeastern Conference, where top-ranked teams suffered unexpected defeats against heavy odds.

grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，結構為be動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: College football history was made on a single Saturday when five of the top seven teams in the Associated Press Top 25 rankings lost their regular-season games.

grammar.explain: 使用逗號連接的V-ing分詞片語，表達伴隨或同時發生的狀態。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, the second-ranked Texas team also lost at home against Florida as Arch Manning faced heavy defensive pressure.

lessons.title: A California town’s beaches are washing away. Can its residents turn the tide?
lessons.title_zh: 美國加州一座小鎮的海灘正被海浪侵蝕消失中：居民能扭轉局勢嗎？

paragraphs.en: Rapid coastal erosion is threatening communities along the southern California coastline, creating an urgent crisis for local towns. In San Clemente, a famous beach town known for surf culture, heavy waves driven by late-summer storms are washing away the sand. This coastal damage is not isolated, as towns from Dana Point to Malibu are also dealing with severe problems. However, San Clemente faces a major challenge because a key regional train line runs directly along the edge of the Pacific Ocean.
paragraphs.zh: 快速的海岸侵蝕正在威脅南加州海岸線沿線的社區，為當地城鎮帶來緊迫的危機。在以衝浪文化聞名著名海灘小鎮聖克 Clemente（San Clemente），由夏末風暴驅動的大浪正將沙子沖走。這種海岸破壞並非個案，因為從達納波特（Dana Point）到馬里布（Malibu）的城鎮也都在處理嚴重的問題。然而，聖克 Clemente 面臨著一項重大挑戰，因為一條重要的區域鐵路線剛好沿著太平洋邊緣運行。

paragraphs.en: Oceanographers from the US Geological Survey (USGS) warn that exceptional erosion events could happen if a predicted Super El Niño develops. Experts explain that these weather conditions might leave coastal infrastructure in pieces and reduce beaches to gravel and bare rock. Although some national politicians continue to deny climate change, local leaders and residents in California now see extreme weather as a real threat. Laguna Beach mayor pro tem Hallie Jones noted that the recent summer proved sea level rise is already here.
paragraphs.zh: 美國地質調查局（USGS）的海洋學家警告說，如果預測的超級聖嬰現象發展，可能會發生異常的侵蝕事件。專家解釋說，這些天氣狀況可能會使海岸基礎設施粉碎，並將海灘縮減為礫紙和裸露的岩石。儘管一些國家政治人物繼續否認氣候變遷，但加州的當地領導人和居民現在將極端天氣視為真正的威脅。拉古納海灘（Laguna Beach）代理市長荷莉·瓊斯（Hallie Jones）指出，最近的夏天證明海平面上升已經來臨。

paragraphs.en: In San Clemente, residents and activists are taking action as the shoreline gets narrower. Cameron Cosgrove, a beach restoration activist, points out that the town is running out of time before the next big wave event hits. Over the past few years, the coastal rail line has been shut down several times for repairs because of landslides and surging tides. Charles Lester, a former head of the California Coastal Commission, warns that rising sea levels could erase a large percentage of California beaches by the year 2100.
paragraphs.zh: 在聖克 Clemente，隨著海岸線變得越來越窄，居民和活動人士正在採取行動。海灘修復活動人士卡梅倫·科斯格羅夫（Cameron Cosgrove）指出，在下一次大浪事件來襲之前，該鎮的時間已經不多了。在過去幾年中，這條海岸鐵路線因山崩和暴潮而多次關閉進行維修。前加州海岸委員會負責人查爾斯·萊斯特（Charles Lester）警告說，到 2100 年，上升的海平面可能會抹去加州很大一部分的海灘。

paragraphs.en: To address this crisis, Cosgrove has authored a local ballot measure for November. He asks voters to voluntarily approve a one percent sales tax to fund beach restoration and wildfire prevention. While many towns in the area are historically conservative, changing weather patterns and soaring temperatures are putting pressure on traditional political views. Local leaders note that ocean temperatures are high and the heat continues longer than before, showing that urgent local responses are needed to protect public spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 為了解決這場危機，科斯格羅夫為 11 月起草了一項地方公投提案。他要求選民自願批准百分之一的營業稅，以資助海灘修復和野火預防。雖然該地區的許多城鎮歷來是保守的，但不斷變化的天氣型態和飆升的氣溫正在對傳統政治觀點施加壓力。當地領導人指出，海水溫度很高，而且高溫持續的時間比以前長，這表明需要採取緊急的地方應對措施來保護公共空間。

grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞的形容詞子句，在此用 which 或 that 引導。
grammar.example: He asks voters to voluntarily approve a one percent sales tax to fund beach restoration and wildfire prevention.
grammar.focus: to fund beach restoration and wildfire prevention

grammar.point: 表目的的不定詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 置於句中或句尾，用來表示某個動作的目的，中譯為「為了……」。
grammar.example: Local leaders note that ocean temperatures are high and the heat continues longer than before, showing that urgent local responses are needed to protect public spaces.

lessons.title: Free clear-up has big engagement on social media
lessons.title_zh: 免費清理環境在社群媒體上引發熱烈關注

paragraphs.en: A fifty-one-year-old resident of Launceston, Cornwall, has become popular on social media by cleaning up neglected public paths in his free time. Jeremy Vernon battles overgrown weeds and clears rubbish to maintain his fitness and help his local community.
paragraphs.zh: 一名來自康瓦爾郡朗塞斯頓的五十一歲居民，利用空閒時間清理荒廢的公共小徑，在社群媒體上大受歡迎。傑瑞米‧弗農透過對抗雜草叢生的植物與清除垃圾來維持體能，並幫助他的當地社區。

paragraphs.en: Vernon works as a self-employed steel erector, taking on jobs that include working on rollercoasters and movie sets. He previously lived in Wiltshire before he was diagnosed with kidney cancer. After having his kidney removed, he relocated back to Cornwall to enjoy a better pace of life.
paragraphs.zh: 弗農是一名獨立接案的鋼骨安裝工，承接的工作包含遊樂設施與電影場景。他在被診斷出罹患腎臟癌之前住在威爾特郡。在切除腎臟後，他搬回康瓦爾郡，以享受更好的生活步調。

paragraphs.en: Despite his previous health issues, he often uses his shovel and wheelbarrow to clear paths when he returns from his work near London. He cleans up areas by cutting back brambles and pressure washing dirty steps, which he finds much better than going to the gym for exercise.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有過健康問題，當他從倫敦附近的 工作地點回來時，經常使用鏟子與獨輪車來清理小徑。他透過砍除黑莓樹叢與用高壓清洗機清洗髒汙的階梯來打掃區域，他發現這比去健身房運動好得多。

paragraphs.en: When Vernon contacted local authorities regarding permission to work on these pathways, he discovered they were not managed by the town council. He contacted Cornwall Council to explain his situation, noting that his public liability insurance might be invalidated because he lacks official permission to work in those public areas.
paragraphs.zh: 當弗農就這些小徑的工作許可聯繫地方當局時，他發現這些並不歸鎮議會管理。他聯繫了康瓦爾郡議會說明他的狀況，並指出因為他缺乏在那些公共區域工作的官方許可，他的公共意外責任險可能會失效。

paragraphs.en: Cornwall Council stated that they strongly support community volunteers and noted that thousands of hours of voluntary work were completed on council land last year. They advised volunteers to register through their contractor Cormac so they can receive proper safety guidelines and ongoing support.
paragraphs.zh: 康瓦爾郡議會表示，他們強烈支持社區志工，並指出去年在議會土地上完成了數萬小時的志願工作。他們建議志工透過其承包商柯馬克進行登記，以便獲得適當的安全指導與持續的支援。

paragraphs.en: Local residents have expressed deep gratitude for his dedication. One resident, Elz Ravenscroft, mentioned that he has worked hard to make public pathways safe for children walking to school, and she believes he truly deserves official recognition for his efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 當地居民對他的奉獻表達了深深的感謝。一名居民艾爾茲‧拉文斯克羅夫特提到，他努力讓公共小徑對走路上學的兒童而言變得安全，並且她相信他的努力確實值得獲得官方的認可。

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 說明使用現在分詞修飾名詞，表示主動或進行的概念。
grammar.example: A fifty-one-year-old resident of Launceston, Cornwall, has become popular on social media by cleaning up neglected public paths in his free time.

grammar.explain: 說明主詞承受動作，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: He previously lived in Wiltshire before he was diagnosed with kidney cancer.

grammar.point: 目的副詞片語 (Adverbial of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 說明使用不定詞片語來表達某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: He relocated back to Cornwall to enjoy a better pace of life.
grammar.focus: to enjoy a better pace of life

lessons.title: Japan to launch world-first mission to collect samples from Martian moon
lessons.title_zh: 日本將發射全球首個任務以採集火星月球樣本

paragraphs.en: The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (Jaxa) is leading a five-year mission to bring back material from Phobos, one of the two moons orbiting Mars. Scientists hope this project will provide clues about how these moons formed and potentially shed light on the origins of life.
paragraphs.zh: 日本宇宙航空研究開發機構（Jaxa）正在主導一項為期五年的任務，旨在將火星兩顆衛星之一的火衛一上的物質帶回地球。科學家希望這個計畫能提供關於這些衛星如何形成的線索，並可能為生命的起源提供啟示。

paragraphs.en: Phobos and Deimos are named after the mythological sons of the war god Ares. While numerous missions have been sent to Mars since the 1960s, its moons remain largely mysterious because previous landing attempts by other nations have failed.
paragraphs.zh: 火衛一和火衛二是以戰神阿瑞斯的希臘神話兒子們命名的。儘管自1960年代以來已有無數次任務被送往火星，但由於其他國家先前登陸的嘗試都失敗了，其衛星在很大程度上仍然充滿神祕。

paragraphs.en: The spacecraft will launch on a new H3 rocket and is expected to reach the Mars region around August 2027. It will then spend three years gathering data and soil samples from Phobos before returning to Earth in 2031.
paragraphs.zh: 該太空船將由一枚新型H3火箭發射，預計於2027年8月左右抵達火星地區。隨後它將花費三年時間從火衛一收集資料與土壤樣本，然後於2031年返回地球。

paragraphs.en: The mission includes a rover jointly developed by France and Germany to explore the surface. As project manager Yasuhiro Kawakatsu noted, Martian moons are known as unclimbed mountains in the solar system, making this research a unique challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 此任務包含一台由法國和德國共同開發以探索地表的探測車。正如專案經理川勝康弘所指出的，火星衛星被稱為太陽系中尚未被攀登的山脈，這使得這項研究成為一項獨特的挑戰。

grammar.explain: 使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞 (named)」來表達主詞被命名的被動意義。
grammar.example: Phobos and Deimos are named after the mythological sons of the war god Ares.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞 (explore)」來表達探測車被開發的目的。
grammar.example: The mission includes a rover jointly developed by France and Germany to explore the surface.

lessons.title: Brewing nor’easter to stir up days of trouble for the Outer Banks and Mid-Atlantic
lessons.title_zh: 東北風暴正在醞釀，預料將為外灘與中大西洋地區帶來數日的麻煩

paragraphs.en: A developing coastal storm known as a nor'easter is expected to bring persistent strong winds, rough seas, and coastal flood threats to parts of North Carolina and the Chesapeake Bay area. This weather system will linger well into next week, creating difficult conditions for the impacted regions.
paragraphs.zh: 一個被稱為「東北風暴」的發展中沿海風暴，預計將為北卡羅來納州部分地區及切薩皮克灣地區帶來持續的強風、風浪粗糙以及沿海洪水的威脅。這個天氣系統將滯留到下週，為受影響地區帶來困難的狀況。

paragraphs.en: Wind will be the primary threat from this weather event. After a strong cold front moves through eastern North Carolina and the Mid-Atlantic, wind speeds will begin to increase. Frequent gusts of 30 to 40 miles per hour are expected inland, while areas in North Carolina's Outer Banks could experience gusts up to 50 miles per hour.
paragraphs.zh: 風力將是這次天氣事件的主要威脅。在強烈的冷鋒掃過北卡羅來納州東部與中大西洋地區之後，風速將開始增強。內陸地區預計會出現每小時30到40英哩的頻繁陣風，而北卡羅來納州的外灘群島地區則可能出現高達每小時50英哩的陣風。

paragraphs.en: As a low-pressure area forms off the coast, winds will become even stronger. Parts of the Outer Banks might see gusts reaching 60 miles per hour, and similar winds could spread northward into coastal Virginia and Maryland. These powerful gusts may damage power lines and cause widespread power outages.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著一個低壓區在海岸外形成，風勢將變得更加強勁。外灘群島的部分地區可能會出現達到每小時60英哩的陣風，類似的強風也可能向北蔓延至維吉尼亞州與馬里蘭州的沿海地區。這些強烈的陣風可能會損壞電線並導致大範圍停電。

paragraphs.en: The severe weather is largely driven by an interaction between the forming storm and a high-pressure system located in southeastern Canada. As the system moves toward a more organized structure by Monday, rainfall will also spread across the region, making outdoor activities unpleasant.
paragraphs.zh: 惡劣的天氣主要受形成中的風暴與位於加拿大東南部的強高壓系統之間的交互作用所驅動。隨著該系統在週一朝向更有組織的結構移動，降雨也將蔓延至整個地區，使戶外活動變得令人不愉快。

paragraphs.en: In addition to wind, coastal flooding presents another major concern. Strong onshore winds will push water toward the shore, leading to minor to moderate flooding during high tides from Sunday through at least midweek. Furthermore, large waves and rough seas will pound the coast for several days, potentially worsening ongoing beach erosion.
paragraphs.zh: 除了風力之外，沿海洪水是另一個主要的擔憂。強烈的離岸風會將海水推向岸邊，導致從週日到至少週中旬的高潮期間出現輕度到中度的洪水。此外，巨浪與粗糙的風浪將拍打海岸數日，這可能會惡化持續中的海灘侵蝕。

paragraphs.en: Meteorologists note that the storm will not start as a tropical system. However, because it is predicted to linger over warm coastal waters for up to a week, experts indicate there is a small chance it could eventually develop into a hybrid system fed by both atmospheric and ocean energy.
paragraphs.zh: 氣象學家指出，該風暴一開始不會是熱帶系統。然而，由於預測它將在溫暖的沿海海水上滯留長達一週，專家表示它最終仍有微小的機會發展成為一個由大氣與海洋能量共同提供動力的混合系統。

grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: A developing coastal storm known as a nor'easter is expected to bring persistent strong winds, rough seas, and coastal flood threats to parts of North Carolina and the Chesapeake Bay area.

grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞的形容詞子句，此處使用 which 或省略受格代名詞來補充說明系統的位置。
grammar.example: The severe weather is largely driven by an interaction between the forming storm and a high-pressure system located in southeastern Canada.

grammar.explain: 用現在分詞表達伴隨發生的狀況或結果，省略連接詞使句子更簡潔。
grammar.example: As the system moves toward a more organized structure by Monday, rainfall will also spread across the region, making outdoor activities unpleasant.

lessons.title: Indiana’s first loss in almost 2 years shows Hoosiers a new, painful side to being in college football’s top tier
lessons.title_zh: 印第安納大學近兩年來首吞敗仗，讓球隊見識到大學美式足球頂尖階級痛苦的一面

paragraphs.en: Indiana football recently suffered its first loss in almost two years, ending a 22-game win streak after a stunning defeat by Ohio State. The game ended with a score of 19-15 due to a crucial mistake on the field. Fans leaving the stadium expressed intense frustration over the missed opportunity to defeat a major conference rival.
paragraphs.zh: 印第安納大學美式足球隊最近吞下了近兩年來的首場敗仗，在遭到俄亥俄州大令人震撼的擊敗後，結束了創下二十二連勝的紀錄。這場比賽因場上的關鍵失誤，最終以十九比十五的比數結束。離開球場的球迷們對錯失擊敗主要聯盟宿敵的機會表達了強烈的沮喪。

paragraphs.en: During the final moments, player Nick Marsh caught a pass in the end zone but failed to keep his foot in bounds. Although he was left completely open during the play, his cleat touched the white boundary line. This accidental error canceled the potential touchdown that could have secured the victory and preserved their historic winning streak.
paragraphs.zh: 在最後時刻，球員尼克·馬許在達陣區接住了傳球，但未能將腳保持在界內。儘管他在這波進攻中完全處於無人防守狀態，他的釘鞋卻碰到了白色界線。這個意外的失誤取消了本可確保勝利並維持其歷史性連勝紀錄的潛在達陣。

paragraphs.en: The unexpected defeat brought deep shock to supporters who had grown accustomed to continuous success. For over six hundred days, the team enjoyed a remarkable period of perfection that included an unforgettable national championship. Fans had quickly embraced their new status as champions, showing their pride through clothing and local business displays.
paragraphs.zh: 這場意料之外的落敗為習慣了持續成功的支持者們帶來了深刻的震撼。在六百多天裡，球隊享有令人矚目的完美時期，其中包括一個令人難忘的全國冠軍。球迷們迅速接受了他們作為冠軍的新身分，透過服飾和當地商家的展示來展現他們的驕傲。

paragraphs.en: However, the team struggled throughout the match with missed opportunities and costly mistakes on offense. Quarterback Josh Hoover noted that the players felt they had beaten themselves through various errors during crucial drives. Despite this painful setback, the team remains hopeful for the remainder of the season and views the experience as a humbling lesson.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，球隊在整場比賽中都在進攻端面臨錯失良機與付出代價的失誤。四分衛喬許·胡佛指出，球員們認為他們在關鍵推進中透過各種錯誤擊敗了自己。儘管遭遇了這個痛苦的挫折，球隊對本賽季剩下的時間仍保持希望，並將這次經驗視為謙卑的一課。

grammar.explain: 使用關代 who 引導形容詞子節，用來修飾前面的先行詞 supporters。
grammar.example: The unexpected defeat brought deep shock to supporters who had grown accustomed to continuous success.
grammar.focus: who had grown accustomed to continuous success

grammar.point: 過去分詞作形容詞 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用過去分詞 stunned 作為形容詞，用來修飾後面的名詞 defeat。
grammar.example: Indiana football recently suffered its first loss in almost two years, ending a 22-game win streak after a stunning defeat by Ohio State.

grammar.explain: 使用 be 動詞加過去分詞構成被動語態，表示主詞球迷們對機會被錯失感到沮喪。
grammar.example: Fans leaving the stadium expressed intense frustration over the missed opportunity to defeat a major conference rival.

lessons.title: ‘Times have changed’: The Italian princess renting out her palace in Rome
lessons.title_zh: 「時代變了」：義大利公主將羅馬宮殿出租

paragraphs.en: In recent travel news, an interesting story from Rome shows how traditional nobility is adapting to modern economic realities. Princess Giacinta Ruspoli and her mother, former Miss Sicily Princess Maria Pia, now rent out their family palace to paying guests.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近的旅遊新聞中，一則來自羅馬的有趣故事展現了傳統貴族如何適應現代的經濟現實。賈琴塔·魯斯波利公主（Princess Giacinta Ruspoli）與她的母親、前西西里小姐瑪麗亞·皮亞公主（Princess Maria Pia）現在將她們家族的宮殿出租給付費的旅客。

paragraphs.en: Upkeep of such historic properties is very expensive, especially since Italy stopped legally recognizing nobility in 1946. Guests can stay in the 16th-century Ruspoli Bonaparte Residence in Rome, where prices start at about $470 per night and include breakfast and butler service.
paragraphs.zh: 維護這樣的歷史房產非常昂貴，特別是在義大利於1946年停止法律上對貴族的承認之後。旅客可以入住位於羅馬、擁有16世紀歷史的魯斯波利波拿巴官邸（Ruspoli Bonaparte Residence），那裡的價格約為每晚470美元起，包含早餐與管家服務。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the Rome palace, visitors also gain entry to Castello Ruspoli, a renovated former hunting estate located thirty miles north of the city. As Princess Giacinta explained, her family wants to share this historic beauty with everyone else because "times have changed."
paragraphs.zh: 除了羅馬的宮殿外，訪客還可以進入魯斯波利城堡（Castello Ruspoli），這是一處位於該城市以北三十英里、經過翻修的前狩獵莊園。正如賈琴塔公主所解釋的，她們的家族希望與其他人分享這份歷史美景，因為「時代變了」。

paragraphs.en: Other global travel and cultural updates include a shift in timekeeping, as international timekeepers voted to replace leap seconds with the leap hour. Meanwhile, morning fitness raves are becoming popular in London, while Hong Kong diners still value eating with extreme speed.
paragraphs.zh: 其他全球旅遊與文化動態包括計時方式的轉變，因為國際計時員投票決定以閏時取代閏秒。同時，早晨健身狂歡派對在倫敦越來越受歡迎，而香港的食客依然重視極速用餐。

grammar.explain: 使用關代where引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的地方先行詞Rome。
grammar.example: Guests can stay in the 16th-century Ruspoli Bonaparte Residence in Rome, where prices start at about $470 per night and include breakfast and butler service.
grammar.focus: where prices start at about $470 per night and include breakfast and butler service

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present participle as adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞paying來修飾名詞guests，表示「付費的」主動狀態。
grammar.example: Princess Giacinta Ruspoli and her mother, former Miss Sicily Princess Maria Pia, now rent out their family palace to paying guests.

lessons.title: AI enters the chaotic world of online dating. User beware
lessons.title_zh: 人工智慧進入混亂的線上約會世界 使用者當心

paragraphs.en: Many single adults are now using artificial intelligence to help navigate online dating. Some users ask chatbots to write profile descriptions, pick photos, or suggest conversation starters to cut through endless swiping. However, this growing trend brings new problems, as people worry about losing authentic human connection and facing misleading information.
paragraphs.zh: 許多單身成年人現在正利用人工智慧來協助應對線上約會。有些使用者請聊天機器人撰寫個人檔案描述、挑選照片或建議開場白，以減少無止盡的滑動。然而，這項逐漸成長的趨勢帶來了新的問題，因為人們擔心失去真實的人際連結並面臨誤導性的資訊。

paragraphs.en: According to experts, dating app companies are introducing AI features to bridge the gap between online chats and meeting in person. While platforms like Bumble and Hinge integrate automated tools for matchmaking and profile creation, some researchers note that these technologies take away human agency. When a person uses AI to chat or fake travel backgrounds, it creates false impressions that can damage trust.
paragraphs.zh: 根據專家表示，交友軟體公司正在導入人工智慧功能，以縮短線上聊天與實際見面之間的距離。雖然像 Bumble 和 Hinge 等平臺整合了用於配對和建立個人檔案的自動化工具，但一些研究人員指出，這些技術剝奪了人類的自主權。當一個人使用人工智慧來聊天或偽造旅遊背景時，會營造出破壞信任的錯誤印象。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, experts raise questions about consent and deception in relationships. If AI-generated content misleads a potential partner, it could impact informed consent to intimacy. In response to fatigue and choice overload from traditional apps, newer platforms require detailed questionnaires to connect users with a smaller pool of matches quickly, aiming to help people move offline sooner.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，專家對戀愛關係中的同意與欺騙提出了質疑。如果人工智慧產生的內容誤導了潛在伴侶，可能會影響對親密關係的知情同意。為了解決傳統交友軟體的疲勞感與選擇過載，較新的平臺要求填寫詳細問卷，以便快速將使用者與較少數的配對物件連結起來，旨在幫助人們更快轉往線下。

paragraphs.en: Although some users hope technology can reduce loneliness, critics warn against automation and the risk of fabricated personas. Security remains a major concern, as individuals must still perform manual safety checks when meeting strangers face to face. Some specialists even suspect that an overreliance on AI could eventually encourage a return to traditional in-person dating events.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有些使用者希望科技能夠減少寂寞感，但批評者警告應防範自動化以及虛構人設的風險。安全性仍然是一大隱憂，因為當人們面對面見到陌生人時，仍必須執行手動安全檢查。有些專家甚至懷疑，過度依賴人工智慧最終可能會鼓勵人們重返傳統的面對面約會活動。

grammar.explain: 本句使用關係代名詞子句修飾前面的名詞短語「problem」，用以補充說明人們擔心的內容。
grammar.example: However, this growing trend brings new problems, as people worry about losing authentic human connection and facing misleading information.
grammar.focus: as people worry about losing authentic human connection and facing misleading information

grammar.explain: 本句使用被動語態結構（be V-pp），強調交友軟體公司正被導入人工智慧功能這一動作。
grammar.example: According to experts, dating app companies are introducing AI features to bridge the gap between online chats and meeting in person.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 本句使用不定詞片語來表達採取某項行動的目的，說明平臺旨在幫助人們更快轉往線下。
grammar.example: In response to fatigue and choice overload from traditional apps, newer platforms require detailed questionnaires to connect users with a smaller pool of matches quickly, aiming to help people move offline sooner.
grammar.focus: to connect users with a smaller pool of matches quickly

lessons.title: Dozens of critically endangered orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfires
lessons.title_zh: 數十隻極度瀕危紅毛猩猩從印尼野火中獲救

paragraphs.en: Rescuers in Indonesia have saved dozens of orangutans from deadly wildfires. This year, a strong El Nino has made the area very hot and dry. Because of this, wildfires have burned millions of acres of land, destroying a large part of the natural home of these animals.
paragraphs.zh: 印尼的救援人員已從致命野火中拯救了數十隻紅毛猩猩。今年，強烈的聖嬰現象使該地區變得非常炎熱乾燥。正因如此，野火已燒毀了數百万英畝的土地，摧毀了這些動物天然棲息地的大部分。

paragraphs.en: Jamartin Sihite, who is the chairman of the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation, explained that more than half of the forest area where these primates live has burned or been damaged by heavy smoke. Both humans and orangutans breathing this air face serious health problems, such as acute respiratory infection.
paragraphs.zh: 婆羅洲紅毛猩猩生存基金會（Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation）主席賈馬丁·西希特（Jamartin Sihite）解釋說，這些靈長類動物生活的森林區域有一半以上已被燒毀或遭受濃煙破壞。吸入這種空氣的人類與紅毛猩猩都面臨嚴重的健康問題，例如急性呼吸道感染。

paragraphs.en: While people can easily put on masks to protect themselves, the animals cannot do so. Various local groups are working hard to rescue and rehabilitate the affected creatures, just as they did during a massive fire season years ago. Experts note that even after the flames are gone, the struggle continues because a lack of food and pollination makes survival very difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然人們可以輕鬆戴上口罩來保護自己，但動物們卻無法做到這一點。各個當地團體正努力救援並復健受影響的生物，就像他們在幾年前的大規模火災季節所做的一樣。專家指出，即使火焰熄滅後，生存之戰仍在繼續，因為缺乏食物與授粉使得生存變得非常艱難。

paragraphs.en: A 5-year-old female named Novita was recently found in the forest canopy, surrounded by smoke and fire. About twenty percent of her body was burned, but she received medical treatment and is now recovering at a center. Conservationists still need to figure out how to protect the remaining population of over one hundred thousand Borneo orangutans.
paragraphs.zh: 一隻名叫諾維塔（Novita）的五歲雌性紅毛猩猩最近在森林樹冠層被發現，周圍被煙霧和烈火包圍。她大約百分之二十的身體被燒傷，但她接受了醫療治療，目前正在一個中心康復。保育人士仍需想辦法保護剩餘的十萬多隻婆羅洲紅毛猩猩。

paragraphs.en: Despite the severe damage, some researchers believe these animals will find a way to get through this crisis. Because orangutans are quite intelligent and resourceful, they can manage to adapt even when their natural habitat becomes heavily degraded.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管受到嚴重破壞，一些研究人員相信這些動物會找到度過這場危機的方法。由於紅毛猩猩相當聰明且富應變能力，即使在自然棲息地嚴重退化時，牠們也能設法適應。

grammar.explain: 用所引導的形容詞子句來補充說明先行詞 Jamartin Sihite 的身份。
grammar.example: Jamartin Sihite, who is the chairman of the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation, explained that more than half of the forest area where these primates live has burned or been damaged by heavy smoke.
grammar.focus: who is the chairman of the Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation

grammar.explain: 用過去分詞片語置於名詞之後，用來修飾受器 Novita，表示她被煙霧與烈火包圍的狀態。
grammar.example: A 5-year-old female named Novita was recently found in the forest canopy, surrounded by smoke and fire.

lessons.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
lessons.title_zh: 人行道上的睡眠者：當親人在醫院接受治療時，他們無處可去

paragraphs.en: In New Delhi, India, many families who travel great distances to public hospitals find themselves sleeping on the sidewalks. Because they cannot afford rental housing during weeks or months of medical treatment, these patients and their relatives set up temporary dwellings on the pavement. People sleep in shifts to make sure they do not miss important calls regarding their loved ones inside.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度新德里，許多長途跋涉前往公立醫院的家庭發現自己睡在人行道上。由於他們無法負擔長達數週或數月醫療期間的租屋費用，這些病患與其親屬便在鋪面上搭建了臨時住所。人們輪流睡眠，以確保不會錯過任何關於他們在裡面親人的重要電話。

paragraphs.en: For instance, Shabana Kumar and her husband travel more than 600 miles from Bihar because the All India Institute of Medical Sciences subsidizes expenses for families in need. Although the hospital helps with medical costs, finding accommodation remains a major challenge that families must handle entirely on their own. They use blankets, sheets, and mosquito nets to create a resting space right beside their belongings.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，夏巴娜·庫瑪爾（Shabana Kumar）和她的丈夫從比哈爾邦（Bihar）旅行了六百多英里遠，因為全印度醫學科學研究所（AIIMS）會補助有需要家庭的費用。儘管該醫院協助醫療開支，但尋找住宿依然是各家庭必須完全自行處理的一大挑戰。他們使用毯子、床單和蚊帳，在隨身物品旁直接打造出休息空間。

paragraphs.en: During the day, families move back and forth between the street and the hospital for tests, appointments, and consultations, while leaving one person behind to watch over their bags. At night, a small community grows around the pavement dwellers as volunteers distribute food and nearby shops provide essential services. As one tea seller notes, he sees countless poor people sleeping outside every single day.
paragraphs.zh: 白天時，各家庭在街頭與醫院之間來回移動以進行檢查、預約和諮詢，同時留下一人看守他們的包包。到了晚上，一個小社群在人行道居民周邊發展起來，志工們分發食物，附近的商店則提供基本服務。正如一位茶水販所言，他每天都看到無數窮人在外面睡覺。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, a young college student named Shalini Yadav has been spending her days reading novels on the pavement outside while waiting for her intestinal illness treatment. Her family traveled roughly 370 miles from Madhya Pradesh and spent thousands of rupees on travel, leaving them unable to afford a room. She shares that sleeping on the road feels both uncomfortable and frightening at night.
paragraphs.zh: 同樣地，一名叫做莎莉妮·亞達夫（Shalini Yadav）的年輕大學生一直在外面的人行道上讀小說打發時間，同時等待她的腸道疾病治療。她的家庭從中央邦（Madhya Pradesh）旅行了大約370英里，並在交通上花費了數千盧比，導致他們無力負擔房間。她分享說，睡在馬路上讓人感到既不舒服又在夜裡令人害怕。

paragraphs.en: Another patient, 62-year-old Lakhi Bai, came from 500 miles away to seek care for diabetes and a condition causing a loss of sensation. Having been sleeping outside for about 20 days without a final treatment plan yet, these individuals illustrate a startling contrast. A hospital providing critical care is surrounded by distressed relatives who have nowhere else to stay.
paragraphs.zh: 另一名病患、62歲的拉基·拜（Lakhi Bai）來自500英里之外，尋求治療糖尿病以及導致失去知覺的病症。在已經外宿大約20天卻尚未有最終治療計畫的情況下，這些個人說明了一個令人震撼的對比。一間提供重症照護的醫院，周圍卻環繞著無處可住的焦慮親屬。

grammar.explain: 使用關代子句來補充說明先行詞 families 的特徵與狀況。
grammar.example: In New Delhi, India, many families who travel great distances to public hospitals find themselves sleeping on the sidewalks.
grammar.focus: who travel great distances to public hospitals

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to 不定詞片語來表達做出某個動作的目的為何。
grammar.example: People sleep in shifts to make sure they do not miss important calls regarding their loved ones inside.
grammar.focus: to make sure they do not miss important calls regarding their loved ones inside

grammar.explain: 使用 be 動詞加上過去分詞來表達受詞承受動作的被動語態。
grammar.example: A hospital providing critical care is surrounded by distressed relatives who have nowhere else to stay.

lessons.title: Long-serving ABC broadcaster Robyn Williams to leave The Science Show after 51 years
lessons.title_zh: 長青廣播員羅賓·威廉斯在主持《科學秀》51年後將卸任

paragraphs.en: Long-serving broadcaster Robyn Williams is leaving the Australian Broadcasting Corporation program The Science Show after leading it for 51 years. The public broadcaster announced this change as part of a plan to refresh its science programming and make room for a new generation. Williams will officially step down in December, and management has not named anyone to replace him yet.
paragraphs.zh: 資深廣播員羅賓·威廉斯（Robyn Williams）在主持澳洲廣播公司（Australian Broadcasting Corporation，簡稱ABC）節目《科學秀》（The Science Show）51年後即將離職。這家公營廣播機構宣布這項人事變動，作為更新其科學節目並為新世代騰出空間計畫的一部分。威廉斯將於12月正式卸任，管理層目前尚未公布接替他人選。

paragraphs.en: This announcement follows shortly after financial journalist Alan Kohler stated his retirement after working for three decades. Both Williams and Kohler will leave their positions at the same time in December. Kohler recently delivered his final finance bulletin on a Wednesday evening. The Australian Broadcasting Corporation managing director Hugh Marks previously discussed the challenge of stopping old formats to make way for modern content.
paragraphs.zh: 這項宣布緊接在財經記者艾倫·科勒（Alan Kohler）表示在工作三十年後退休之後不久。威廉斯與科勒兩人將於12月同時離開職位。科勒最近在一個週三晚上發表了他的最後一份財經快報。澳洲廣播公司總經理休·馬克斯（Hugh Marks）先前曾討論過停止舊節目形式以替現代內容讓路的挑戰。

paragraphs.en: Although insiders claimed that Williams would prefer to continue working for many more years, the management is eager to push for generational change. To honor his long service, the organization offered him the opportunity to produce several science documentaries in the year 2027. Williams expressed that his long career had been an enduring pleasure, stating that these years brought excitement and hard work.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然內部人士稱威廉斯更願意繼續工作更多年，但管理層急於推動世代交替。為了表彰他的長期服務，該機構提供了他在2027年製作數部科學紀錄片的機會。威廉斯表示他漫長的職業生涯是一項持久的樂趣，並指出這些年來帶來了興奮與辛勤的工作。

paragraphs.en: Throughout his remarkable career, Williams has reported actively on the climate crisis and conducted important investigations into dangerous materials and medical errors. He has received high honors, including being made a Member of the Order of Australia and receiving several honorary doctorates from major universities.
paragraphs.zh: 在他卓越的職業生涯中，威廉斯積極報導氣候危機，並對危險物質及醫療疏失進行了重要的調查。他獲得了崇高的榮譽，包括被授予澳洲勳章成員，並獲得多所主要大學頒發的榮譽博士學位。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 此處的不定詞片語用來表達採取某項行動的目的（即為了更新科學節目）。
grammar.example: The public broadcaster announced this change as part of a plan to refresh its science programming and make room for a new generation.

grammar.explain: 此句使用被動語態，強調主詞接替人選尚未被管理層命名或公布。
grammar.example: Williams will officially step down in December, and management has not named anyone to replace him yet.
grammar.focus: has not named anyone to replace him

grammar.explain: 此處使用關係代名詞片語來補充說明多所大學所頒發的榮譽博士學位。
grammar.example: He has received high honors, including being made a Member of the Order of Australia and receiving several honorary doctorates from major universities.
grammar.focus: including being made a Member of the Order of Australia

lessons.title: £800,000 spent on scrapped sports dome project
lessons.title_zh: 已取消的體育巨蛋計畫耗資80萬英鎊

paragraphs.en: Ulster University (UU) in Northern Ireland has revealed that it spent £800,000 on an indoor sports arena before canceling the plan. First unveiled in 2024, the multimillion-pound facility in Londonderry was intended to host various activities, including rugby, football, and Gaelic games. However, the university scrapped the project in August because officials realized it was no longer financially possible to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 北愛爾蘭的阿爾斯特大學（Ulster University，簡稱 UU）透露，該校在取消計畫前，已在一座室內體育場館上花費了80萬英鎊。這座位於倫敦德里（Londonderry）、耗資數百萬英鎊的設施於2024年首次亮相，原先預計容納包含橄欖球、足球和蓋爾式運動在內的多種活動。然而，該大學在8月份取消了該計畫，因為相關主管意識到在財務上已無法繼續推行。

paragraphs.en: Details about the spending emerged after a Freedom of Information request from BBC Radio Foyle. The university explained that roughly £700,000 went toward project-related activities, while another £100,000 was used for governance and management. This disclosure came at a difficult time for UU, which previously announced it had to save around £25m and lay off up to 450 workers.
paragraphs.zh: 在英國廣播公司福伊爾廣播電台（BBC Radio Foyle）提出《資訊自由法》申請後，這筆支出的相關細節隨之曝光。該大學說明，大約有70萬英鎊用於與計畫相關的活動，另外10萬英鎊則用於治理與管理。這項揭露正值 UU 的艱困時期，該校先前已宣布必須節省約2500萬英鎊，並裁員多達450名員工。

paragraphs.en: Estimated building expenses had surged from an original £16.8m to £20.1m by the time leaders abandoned the idea. In addition, operating the 15,000-square-metre venue would have required more than £1m each year. The complex was supposed to receive £9.16m (€10.86m) from PeacePlus, an international programme supported by the European Union, the UK, the Irish government, and Stormont, alongside £8.3m from UU.
paragraphs.zh: 在負責人放棄該構想時，預估的建築費用已從最初的1680萬英鎊飆升至2010萬英鎊。此外，若要營運這座占地1萬5000平方公尺的場館，每年需要花費超過100萬英鎊。該綜合場館原定從由歐盟、英國政府、愛爾蘭政府和斯托蒙特（Stormont）共同支持的國際「PeacePlus」計畫獲得916萬英鎊（1086萬歐元），並由 UU 提供830萬英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Criticism followed the revelation. Sinéad McLaughlin, an SDLP assembly member, questioned why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion. She noted that Northern Ireland's higher education system faced a funding crisis, meaning the university could never maintain the facility. Meanwhile, the university stated that ending the plan was "an inevitable consequence" of the wider financial difficulties in the sector.
paragraphs.zh: 此消息曝光後引發了批評。社會民主工黨（SDLP）議會成員西妮德．麥克勞克林（Sinéad McLaughlin）質疑，為何在得出這樣的結論之前，就耗費了如此多的公帑。她指出北愛爾蘭的高等教育體系正面臨財務危機，意味著該大學絕不可能維持該場館的維護運作。與此同時，該大學表示，停止這項計畫是該領域更廣泛財務困境下的「必然結果」。

paragraphs.en: The Special EU Programmes Body (SEUPB) confirmed that no PeacePlus money had been distributed for the building. Officials stated that they are now looking for ways to redirect the remaining funds to other helpful community developments. However, the agency could not promise that the reallocated money would stay in the north-west region.
paragraphs.zh: 特殊歐盟計畫機構（SEUPB）證實，尚未針對該建築發放任何 PeacePlus 資金。官員表示，他們目前正在尋找將剩餘資金重新分配至其他有益社區發展專案的方案。然而，該機構無法承諾重新分配的資金會留在西北部地區。

grammar.explain: 以「had + 過去分詞」表示在過去另一個動作（放棄計畫）發生前就已經完成的事件或趨勢。
grammar.example: Estimated building expenses had surged from an original £16.8m to £20.1m by the time leaders abandoned the idea.

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由疑問詞「why」引導名詞子句，在主要子句動詞「questioned」後面充當受詞。
grammar.example: Sinéad McLaughlin, an SDLP assembly member, questioned why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion.
grammar.focus: why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion

grammar.explain: 在逗號之後使用現在分詞「meaning」引導分詞片語，修飾前面的整個子句，用來補充說明帶來的結果。
grammar.example: She noted that Northern Ireland's higher education system faced a funding crisis, meaning the university could never maintain the facility.
grammar.focus: , meaning the university could never maintain the facility

lessons.title: At SF Tech Week, a vibe check on how people in Silicon Valley feel about the AI boom
lessons.title_zh: 在舊金山科技週（SF Tech Week），人們對矽谷人工智慧熱潮感受的氣氛檢測

paragraphs.en: During San Francisco Tech Week, tech workers, startup founders, and investors gathered to discuss the rapid growth of artificial intelligence. Many people feel excited about this new technology, but they also worry about how long the excitement will last.
paragraphs.zh: 在舊金山科技週期間，科技工作者、新創公司創辦人和投資人齊聚一堂，討論人工智慧的快速發展。許多人對這項新技術感到興奮，但也擔憂這股熱潮能持續多久。

paragraphs.en: The week-long festival featured many different activities, including expert lectures and morning cold plunges in the bay. Laur Laanemets traveled from Estonia to attend the event and noted that the local excitement feels both hot and scary.
paragraphs.zh: 這為期一週的節慶包含了許多不同的活動，包含專家講座以及在海灣早晨的冷水潛水。勞爾·拉內梅茨（Laur Laanemets）從愛沙尼亞前來參加活動，並指出當地的那種熱情既火熱又令人害怕。

paragraphs.en: As money floods into the industry and company values rise, huge questions remain about whether these new businesses can turn profits. Furthermore, participants watched a fun pitch competition where startup founders presented unusual ideas, such as clearing the city fog with heaters near the Golden Gate Bridge.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著資金湧入該產業且公司市值上升，關於這些新企業能否獲利仍存在巨大的疑問。此外，參與者觀看了一場趣味募資競賽，新創公司創辦人提出了不尋常的點子，例如用金門大橋附近的加熱器來清除城市霧氣。

paragraphs.en: Peter Day, a general partner at a venture capital firm, believes that the energy in Silicon Valley is invigorating because it helps people solve problems that were once impossible. However, he also noted that AI is changing the job market and causing economic disruption, making it harder for recent graduates to find entry-level positions.
paragraphs.zh: 一家創投公司的普通合夥人彼得·戴（Peter Day）認為，矽谷的活力令人振奮，因為它幫助人們解決了曾經不可能解決的問題。然而他也指出，人工智慧正在改變就業市場並造成經濟衝擊，使得剛畢業的人更難找到入門級職位。

paragraphs.en: Another investor, Drew Glover, compared the situation to the dot-com bust around the year 2000. He warned that some companies with small teams and zero revenue are receiving massive valuations, creating a risky bubble where nobody knows the true value of the technology yet.
paragraphs.zh: 另一位投資人德魯·格洛弗（Drew Glover）將這種情況與公元2000年前後的網際網路泡沫破裂進行了比較。他警告說，一些團隊規模小且沒有收入的公司正獲得巨大的估值，這創造了一個充滿風險的泡沫，目前還沒有人知道這項技術的真實價值。

grammar.explain: 此處使用關代子句來修飾先行詞 events，補充說明活動包含哪些內容。
grammar.example: The week-long festival featured many different activities, including expert lectures and morning cold plunges in the bay.

grammar.point: 過去分詞作形容詞 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 句中的過去分詞 excited 用來形容主詞 Many people 的心理狀態。
grammar.example: Many people feel excited about this new technology, but they also worry about how long the excitement will last.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 此處的不定詞片語用來表達旅行的目的。
grammar.example: Laur Laanemets traveled from Estonia to attend the event and noted that the local excitement feels both hot and scary.

lessons.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
lessons.title_zh: 有毒演算法糾纏不休——如今澳洲想設下關閉開關

paragraphs.en: Many young people experience serious harm from recommender algorithms on social media. In Australia, Varsha Yajman battled an eating disorder as a teenager after platforms constantly showed her dangerous diet challenges. In another case, Flynn Martin was drawn into toxic and hateful online groups while dealing with mental health struggles. Both individuals believe that automated content recommendations played a key role during the most painful chapters of their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 許多青少年在社群媒體上面臨推薦演算法帶來的嚴重傷害。在澳洲，瓦莎·亞吉曼（Varsha Yajman）在青少年時期於平台不斷向她展示危險的節食挑戰後，陷入了飲食失調的痛苦掙扎。在另一個案例中，弗林·馬丁（Flynn Martin）在面對心理健康問題的同時，被吸入了有害且充滿仇恨的網路群體中。兩人都認為，自動化的內容推薦在他們人生中最痛苦的篇章中扮演了關鍵角色。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, the Australian government recently introduced a new suite of laws to parliament. The central proposal is an algorithm switch that would require platforms to let users turn off recommended posts. This change would allow people to see only updates from accounts they actually follow. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese defended the idea, stating, "This is not about giving government control, it is about giving people control."
paragraphs.zh: 為了解決這些問題，澳洲政府最近向國會提交了一套新法案。其核心提案是一項演算法開關，要求平台允許使用者關閉推薦內容。這項改變將讓人們只能看到自己實際追蹤的帳號所發布的動態。總理安東尼·艾班尼斯（Anthony Albanese）為此構想辯護時表示：「這不是給政府控制權，而是給人民控制權。」

paragraphs.en: The policy was inspired by activist Chanel Contos, who led a public campaign called "Fix Our Feeds." Her petition attracted more than 15,000 signatures along with support from lawmakers and mental health advocates. The proposal is included in the Digital Duty of Care bill, which forces online platforms, gaming websites, and chatbots to ensure safety. Tech companies that violate these standards could face fines of up to 100 million Australian dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 這項政策受到了倡議者夏奈爾·康托斯（Chanel Contos）的啟發，她發起了一場名為「修正我們的動態」的公開運動。她的請願書吸引了超過一萬五千人簽署，並獲得立法委員和心理健康倡議人士的支持。這項提案被納入《數位注意義務法案》，該法案強制網路平台、遊戲網站及聊天機器人確保安全環境。違反這些標準的科技公司可能面臨最高一億澳幣的罰款。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, the plan faces significant debate and practical challenges. Critics, including the Trump administration, argue that the legislation threatens free speech and might cause excessive censorship. Furthermore, tech experts point to the European Union, where similar controls produced poor results because platforms created clunky interfaces that discouraged users. As Australia prepares to enforce the new law, observers wonder whether it can truly solve the problem of digital addiction.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管如此，這項計畫仍面臨重大爭論與實際挑戰。包括川普政府在內的批評者主張，該法案威脅了言論自由，並可能導致過度審查。此外，科技專家指出歐盟的例子，當地類似的管制措施成效不佳，因為平台設計了笨拙難用的介面，讓使用者打退堂鼓。隨著澳洲準備執行這項新法律，觀察人士質疑它是否真能解決數位成癮的問題。

grammar.point: 不定詞片語表目的 (Infinitive Phrase of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首使用不定詞片語 To address these issues，用來修飾主要子句並說明提出新法案的目的。
grammar.example: To address these issues, the Australian government recently introduced a new suite of laws to parliament.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with a Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 引導形容詞子句修飾先行詞 an algorithm switch，在子句中作主詞使用。
grammar.example: The central proposal is an algorithm switch that would require platforms to let users turn off recommended posts.
grammar.focus: that would require platforms to let users turn off recommended posts

grammar.explain: 以 be 動詞 was 搭配過去分詞 inspired，構成過去簡單式的被動語態，表示政策受到啟發。
grammar.example: The policy was inspired by activist Chanel Contos, who led a public campaign called "Fix Our Feeds."

lessons.title: Hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia – OB-GYNS set new rules for menopause treatment
lessons.title_zh: 潮熱、盜汗、失眠——婦產科醫師為更年期治療訂定新準則

paragraphs.en: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) has updated its guidelines for treating menopause symptoms for the first time since 2014. Millions of women experience problems such as hot flashes, night sweats, sleep loss, and mood swings. To address these issues, the medical group now recommends hormone replacement therapy (HRT) alongside newer nonhormonal medicines and lifestyle changes, giving doctors more options to create personalized care plans.
paragraphs.zh: 美國婦產科醫學會（ACOG）自2014年以來，首次更新了更年期症狀的治療指引。數百萬名女性經歷著潮熱、盜汗、睡眠障礙以及情緒起伏等困擾。為了應對這些問題，該醫療組織現在建議將荷爾蒙替代療法（HRT）與較新的非荷爾蒙藥物及生活型態改變搭配使用，讓醫師有更多選擇來制定個人化的照護計畫。

paragraphs.en: In 2002, an earlier study raised serious concerns that HRT might increase the risk of heart disease, stroke, and breast cancer. However, researchers later reexamined the data and discovered significant limitations. For example, most participants in that study were 60 or older, so the findings could not represent younger women. Co-author Dr. Robert Kauffman stated that hormone therapy remains the best choice for symptomatic women who recently entered menopause or are younger than 60.
paragraphs.zh: 2002年，一項早期的研究引發了嚴重擔憂，認為荷爾蒙替代療法可能增加心臟病、中風和乳癌的風險。然而，研究人員後來重新檢視了資料，發現了重大的局限性。舉例來說，該研究中的大多數參與者年齡都在60歲或以上，因此這些發現無法代表較年輕的女性。共同作者羅伯特·考夫曼醫師（Dr. Robert Kauffman）指出，對於有症狀且剛進入更年期或年齡小於60歲的女性而言，荷爾蒙療法仍然是最佳選擇。

paragraphs.en: Under the new guidance, women who still have a uterus should receive both estrogen and progestogen because progestogen protects the uterine lining from cancer. Women without a uterus may take estrogen alone. However, people with certain health conditions, including liver disease, blood clots, or a history of stroke, should avoid hormone therapy. For those who cannot use hormones, doctors suggest newer drugs like fezolinetant or medicines such as gabapentin.
paragraphs.zh: 在新指引下，仍有子宮的女性應同時接受雌激素與黃體素，因為黃體素能保護子宮內膜免於罹癌。沒有子宮的女性則可以單獨使用雌激素。然而，患有特定健康狀況的人，包括肝臟疾病、血栓或有中風病史者，應避免接受荷爾蒙治療。對於不能使用荷爾蒙的人，醫師建議使用如非唑奈坦（fezolinetant）等較新的藥物，或如加巴噴丁（gabapentin）這類的藥物。

paragraphs.en: Lifestyle modifications can also help relieve mild discomfort. According to ACOG, regular exercise, a balanced diet, and cognitive behavioral therapy can support patients, even though the scientific evidence for these methods is weaker than that for HRT. Due to growing demand, some estrogen products have recently faced shortages. Therefore, health experts urge women to discuss both benefits and risks with trusted doctors instead of focusing on a single treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 改變生活型態也有助於緩解輕微的不適。根據美國婦產科醫學會的說法，規律運動、均衡飲食和認知行為治療能為患者提供幫助，儘管這些方法的科學證據比荷爾蒙替代療法來得弱。由於需求不斷增長，一些雌激素產品近期面臨短缺。因此，健康專家呼籲女性應與值得信賴的醫師討論優缺點，而非只專注於單一治療選擇。

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首使用「To + 原形動詞」表示目的，用來說明採取後續行動的原因，語意為「為了應對這些問題」。
grammar.example: To address these issues, the medical group now recommends hormone replacement therapy (HRT) alongside newer nonhormonal medicines and lifestyle changes, giving doctors more options to create personalized care plans.

grammar.explain: 連接詞 that 引導完整的名詞子句置於抽象名詞 concerns 之後，作為同位語以具體說明擔憂的內容。
grammar.example: In 2002, an earlier study raised serious concerns that HRT might increase the risk of heart disease, stroke, and breast cancer.
grammar.focus: that HRT might increase the risk of heart disease, stroke, and breast cancer

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 代替先行詞 women 並在子句中作主詞，引導形容詞子句修飾限定該群女性。
grammar.example: Under the new guidance, women who still have a uterus should receive both estrogen and progestogen because progestogen protects the uterine lining from cancer.

lessons.title: Our business ads were taken down for saying 'pregnancy' on Instagram
lessons.title_zh: 我們的商業廣告在Instagram上因為提到「懷孕」而被下架

paragraphs.en: In early 2025, business owner Irene Breen received a surprising notification stating that Instagram was removing advertisements for her company's pregnancy pillows. She later learned from Meta, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, that the issue was the specific word included in her product name. To fix this problem, she had to completely clear that term from her entire website and rename her web addresses. Although the platform eventually lifted these restrictions after ten months of communication, her company suffered a significant financial loss during this period.
paragraphs.zh: 在2025年初期，企業主愛琳·布林收到了一則令人驚訝的通知，指出Instagram正在移除她公司懷孕枕頭的廣告。她後來從Instagram和Facebook的母公司Meta得知，問題在於她產品名稱中包含的這個特定詞彙。為了解決這個問題，她必須從整個網站中完全清除該詞彙並重新命名她的網址。雖然該平台在經過十個月的溝通後終於解除這些限制，但她的公司在這段期間遭受了重大的財務損失。

paragraphs.en: Meta explained that while businesses are permitted to promote wellness and reproductive items, rules exist to prevent users from having negative experiences across different cultures. However, the company later clarified that individuals are allowed to freely use the term in regular posts and discussions. Despite this explanation, many creators and charities focusing on women's health report that their materials are frequently removed, hidden by sensitivity filters, or affected by a practice known as shadowbanning.
paragraphs.zh: Meta解釋說，雖然企業被允許推廣健康和生殖用品，但存在相關規定以防止使用者在不同文化中擁有負面體驗。然而，該公司隨後澄清，個人被允許在一般貼文和討論中自由使用該詞彙。儘管有此解釋，許多專注於女性健康的創作者和慈善機構回報，他們的資料經常被移除、被敏感度過濾器隱藏，或是受到被稱為「影子禁言」的做法影響。

paragraphs.en: A campaign group named CensHERship recently published a report surveying nearly two hundred creators, health brands, and educators, with ninety-six percent stating they had faced various content restrictions. Experts note that platforms often rely on automated artificial intelligence systems to check posts against guidelines. Unfortunately, this technology can make mistakes and repeat previous errors without giving users a proper way to question the decision.
paragraphs.zh: 名為CensHERship的倡議團體最近發布了一份報告，調查了將近兩百位創作者、健康品牌和教育工作者，其中百分之九十六表示他們曾面臨各種內容限制。專家指出，平台經常依賴自動化的人工智慧系統來對照準則檢查貼文。不幸的是，這項科技可能會犯錯並重複先前的錯誤，卻沒有給使用者適當的管道來質疑該決定。

paragraphs.en: For instance, Athena Lamnisos, the chief executive officer of the gynaecological cancer charity Eve Appeal, shared that an educational diagram about vulval anatomy and cancer was pulled down by the platform. Although the post eventually reappeared behind a sensitivity filter after a lengthy appeal process, critical health information is still failing to reach people who need it urgently. Similarly, Deirdre O'Neill from the fertility test company Hertility reported that a video simply describing a woman's pain with endometriosis was incorrectly classified as political content and removed.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，婦科癌症慈善機構「Eve Appeal」的執行長雅典娜·拉姆尼索斯分享說，一張關於外陰解剖結構與癌症的教育圖表被該平台撤下。儘管該貼文在經過漫長的申訴流程後，最終在敏感度過濾器後方重新出現，但關鍵的健康資訊依然未能傳達給急需之的人。同樣地，來自生育檢測公司Hertility的迪爾德麗·奧尼爾回報，一段單純描述女性子宮內膜異位症痛苦的影片被錯誤分類為政治內容並遭到移除。

paragraphs.en: As a result of these strict moderation practices, a growing number of respondents are turning to self-censorship, such as using alternative spellings, emojis, or avoiding specific topics entirely. Representatives from advocacy groups warn that this trend is deeply damaging because it reinforces historical shame and guilt surrounding women's health. While social media companies claim they are consulting with health organizations to improve their systems, advocates emphasize that much work remains to be done to ensure important educational content is no longer suppressed.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些嚴格的審查做法，越來越多的受訪者轉向自我審查，例如使用替代拼法、表情符號，或完全避開特定主題。倡議團體的代表警告說，這種趨勢具有極大的破壞力，因為它強化了圍繞著女性健康的歷史羞恥感與罪惡感。雖然社群媒體公司聲稱他們正與健康組織諮詢以改善其系統，但倡議人士強調，仍有許多工作需要完成，以確保重要的教育內容不再被壓制。

grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，結構為「be 動詞 + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: To fix this problem, she had to completely clear that term from her entire website and rename her web addresses.

grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞 who 來引導子句，修飾前面的先行詞 creators and charities。
grammar.example: Despite this explanation, many creators and charities focusing on women's health report that their materials are frequently removed...

grammar.point: 副詞子句表原因 (Adverbial Clause of Reason)
grammar.explain: 用來表達動作發生的原因，在此處由連接詞 because 引導。
grammar.example: Representatives from advocacy groups warn that this trend is deeply damaging because it reinforces historical shame and guilt surrounding women's health.
grammar.focus: because it reinforces historical shame and guilt surrounding women's health

lessons.title: Public health nurse talks about the moment she learned to ask for help
lessons.title_zh: 公衛護士談論她學會尋求協助的那一刻

paragraphs.en: Afaf Saleh, a public health nurse in Minnesota who is the daughter of Somali immigrants, recently spoke with her college mentor about a time she almost quit her nursing career. More than a decade ago, she faced overwhelming responsibilities while studying in nursing school.
paragraphs.zh: 明尼蘇達州的公衛護士阿法·薩利赫（Afaf Saleh）是索馬利亞移民的女兒，她最近與大學導師談論了一次她差點放棄護理職涯的經歷。十多年前，她在就讀護理學校時面臨了排山倒海的責任。

paragraphs.en: At that time, Saleh was working full-time, acting as a stand-in mother, and managing nearly everything for her family, including her seven siblings and her ailing mother. The extreme pressure eventually caused her to fail a class, leading to notice that she would be dismissed from the nursing program.
paragraphs.zh: 當時，薩利赫從事全職工作，扮演代理母親的角色，並為她的家人處理幾乎所有事情，包括她的七個手足和生病的母親。極大的壓力最終導致她有一門課被當掉，並接到她將被護理系退學的通知。

paragraphs.en: Facing this crisis, Saleh first prayed and then poured her heart into an appeal letter, explaining all the heavy burdens she carried as a young student. Soon after, her mentor Suzanne Burke Lehman contacted her to ask why she had stayed silent about her struggles.
paragraphs.zh: 面對這場危機，薩利赫先是祈禱，接著將滿腔心血傾注於一封申訴信中，解釋她身為年輕學生所承擔的所有沉重負擔。不久之後，她的導師蘇珊·伯克·萊曼（Suzanne Burke Lehman）聯繫她，詢問她為何對自己的困境保持沉默。

paragraphs.en: During their meeting in the office, Lehman told Saleh that she saw herself in her former student, which made Saleh realize she did not have to handle everything alone. Lehman later shared that teaching her made her realize how close help was for those who need it.
paragraphs.zh: 在辦公室會面期間，萊曼告訴薩利赫，她在這位前學生身上看到了自己的影子，這讓薩利赫意識到她不必獨自處理一切。萊曼後來分享說，教導薩利赫讓她體會到，對於需要幫助的人而言，援助其實是多麼近在咫尺。

paragraphs.en: With this vital support, Saleh ultimately graduated at the top of her class and is now a public health nurse in Minneapolis. Lehman currently serves as the dean of St. Catherine University's School of Nursing, and their inspiring conversation has been preserved at the Library of Congress.
paragraphs.zh: 有了這項關鍵支持，薩利赫最終以優異成績從班上畢業，如今在明neapolis擔任公衛護士。萊曼目前擔任聖凱瑟琳大學護理學院院長，他們深具啟發性的對話已被美國國會圖書館典藏。

phrases.phrase: graduate at the top of one's class
phrases.zh: 以優異成績第一名畢業

grammar.explain: 使用關代 who 引導子句來修飾先行詞 a public health nurse in Minnesota。
grammar.example: Afaf Saleh, a public health nurse in Minnesota who is the daughter of Somali immigrants, recently spoke with her college mentor about a time she almost quit her nursing career.
grammar.focus: who is the daughter of Somali immigrants

grammar.explain: 使用 be 動詞加過去分詞 (is preserved) 來表達對話被美國國會圖書館典藏的被動意義。
grammar.example: Lehman currently serves as the dean of St. Catherine University's School of Nursing, and their inspiring conversation has been preserved at the Library of Congress.

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞 leading 開頭的逗號隔開子句，用來補充說明前面事情所導致的結果。
grammar.example: At that time, Saleh was working full-time, acting as a stand-in mother, and managing nearly everything for her family, including her seven siblings and her ailing mother. The extreme pressure eventually caused her to fail a class, leading to notice that she would be dismissed from the nursing program.
grammar.focus: leading to notice that she would be dismissed from the nursing program
